I have already close to 60 hours in this latest iteration of my favorite series, and unfortunately, I have mixed feelings. Setting aside the obvious (but aggravating) bugs and other technical issues, as they will most likely be addressed in updates and hotfixes, I think FM 26 simply wasn't ambitious enough in the right places. It does, however, succeed in the promised tactical innovations.

Where it was ambitious but fell short - the UI: The UI overhaul certainly is visually impressive at first glance but really creates a clunky experience when playing the game and navigating through different menus and pages. SI have attributed this to a need for hardcore FM players like myself to "unlearn" what we knew before, but I believe it is more down to poor design choices. It simply is not intuitive in many places. In others, it feels awkward because it was clearly designed to cater to console players.

Where it was ambitious and succeeded - tactics: The tactics overhaul in this iteration of FM has truly been fantastic to tinker with. I have always enjoyed the tactical side of the game, and FM 26 has introduced a new level of freedom to tactical-minded managers. While some of the player position terminology is a bit clunky (still better than the outdated terms used before), the overall tactical enhancements are clear. What is more, the game itself seems to respond to a larger variety of tactical choices when compared to previous FM games. In my season-long Braga save, I qualified for the Champion's League using a conservative mid-block approach paired with shorter passing and a lower tempo. In past iterations of FM, it was often difficult to avoid switching to a high pressing, high tempo tactical approach when in poor form. I also briefly tested a defensively solid counter-attack approach with Nottingham Forest, with moderate success.  I do think the only thing holding back these tactical innovations is the UI, which makes messing with tactics at best, awkward and at worst, frustrating. 

Where it was not ambitious enough - the game itself: Aside from the UI and the visual "coat of paint," this is still the same FM we've been getting for years. While, for some, this could be perceived as a positive, I think after waiting two years, I am disappointed with the lack of innovation here. Yes, there are new animations, like players looking up before driving a low cross into the box for a poaching striker to pounce on, but the actual core experience has not changed. In many cases, issues that the FM community have had with the game for over a decade are still present. Players will demand insane wages from you before signing for a team with less standing for lower wages and lower playing time. 

Where its ambition was oversold - the graphical enhancements: While I have never played Football Manager for the graphics or visual experience, I do think SI oversold this aspect of FM 26. It looks... fine. The most notable improvements are to non-human objects, like trophies, balls, etc. However, the in-game character models are still well over a decade behind other titles. For years, FM players have complained about the strange and unrealistic newgen (players generated by the game) faces. This is still a glaring issue here. I believe the improved and far more varied animations I mentioned previously mask many of the issues with graphical fidelity, making a match feel more "real" when watching it unfold from afar.

Conclusions: I am leaving this somewhat negative review out of a sense of duty to the FM community rather than to dog-pile criticism on SI. I genuinely love these games and only share my criticisms to offer constructive criticism as a hardcore player.  I only hope that SI takes the FM community's thoughts into account moving forward as they continue updating FM 26 and producing future titles. Long live Football Manager.

Strongly recommended, but with a major caveat. Yes, Gloomwood really scratches that old Thief itch and is likely my favorite stealth game since MGSV: The Phantom Pain, but that Early Access tag is likely not going anywhere anytime soon. Granted, this is a New Blood game, the same studio that published Ultrakill, which has been in early access for even longer. A common thread between these two games is that they are both excellent from practically every angle but are also both unfinished from a content perspective. This is not a knock at either development teams as they are both small and, from a technical standpoint, both games are beautifully optimized. However, with Gloomwood, its unfinished state stands out a little more. Updates have been slow, but that's likely because they're thoroughly tested as, again, it's very well optimized. To the developer's credit, they are honest on the store page about it likely being several years before the 1.0 version launches, and to be honest it does get a little repetitive having to restart after each major update, slow as they may arrive. But when the level design and mechanics are this polished, it's easy to see that the finished product will be more than worth the wait. I would pick it up now during Early Access as it will likely jump a bit in price once it launches officially and enjoy some good ol' fashioned 90's inspired stealth-'em-up goodness, then join the rest of us Doctors and eagerly await its full release.

O jogo é ótimo, mas tem um problema: o travamento.

 Você não consegue colocar mais que um veículo; se colocar mais que isso, o jogo trava. 

Dependendo do veículo, só de iniciar (ou 'spawnar'), ele já trava.

 É um ponto que precisa melhorar, mas, tirando isso, o jogo permite que você faça qualquer coisa no mundo aberto, desde resgatar na tempestade em alto mar ou até resgatar um submarino abaixo de 200m de profundidade, ou até mesmo reabastecer em voo. 

É ótimo! E se você comprar a DLC 'Procurar e Destruir' (ou 'Buscar e Destruir'), o jogo fica excelente, pois você pode atacar avião, helicóptero e bases inimigas. 

O ÚNICO PROBLEMA é que, quando você chega perto, o jogo vai travar, e ele vai travar muito na hora em que os navios 'spawnarem'. Tipo, o jogo fica em câmera lenta, e não tem como desativar as bases.

 Eu recomendo baixar mods que fazem os inimigos patrulhar pelo mapa, onde é apenas um forte, e assim o jogo não trava. Quanto ao barco, também recomendo criar mais, mas é difícil caso queira que ele seja do seu jeito. 

Enfim, é um detalhe. Além disso, seria bom baixar um mod para desativar o 'fog' (a névoa), que é um fator que prejudica a visibilidade. Eu estava com o 'fog' no mínimo, com visibilidade de 20km, e mesmo assim não estava vendo o helicóptero a 500m. 

Poxa, é sacanagem! Mesmo depois de tirar o 'fog', o jogo não permitia que eu visse com a visibilidade em 20km e 'fog 0%'. Portanto, eu recomendo tirar o 'fog'! Baixe um mod que faça isso: ele só vai remover a névoa do jogo em si; se você colocar 50% de 'fog' nas configurações de clima, o efeito ainda aparecerá.

 Ele só remove o 'fog' padrão do jogo, mantendo o clima. Assim, se o clima estiver em 0% de névoa, você verá bem de longe; se estiver em 60%, a visibilidade será de média a curta distância. 

Outra sugestão é que seria legal se os desenvolvedores mexessem no som. 

Por exemplo, não existe um sistema de abafamento: com todas as portas fechadas, o som do motor deveria ser abafado, entre outras coisas. 

Por fim, também recomendo baixar mods de resgate para resgatar você (jogador). Você vai precisar, kkkkkk, pode confiar! 

Recomendo este e outros mods. 

Tem grandes aventuras pelo jogo, e é bom demais!

This is the most unbalanced Roguelike I've ever played.

This game actively repels newcomers with how obtuse it is to actually succeed in a full run, yet I still recommend it.

The lack of balance in this game requires you to mentally, aggressively tier list all of the cards. Low cost cards are nearly always objectively better. Heart cards are also nearly objectively better as they are your only source of survivability and I beg that all new players start off with the Heart deck.

Since this is Blackjack and the only initial options are Hit and Stand. That means that cards that give you alternative options are also objectively better.

Once you understand all of that, then this game becomes playable. I've beaten the highest ascension with 6-7 different decks and I now know what the game wants from me so I was eventually able to do so easily but it does not tell you that clearly.

This game is pretty great and I hope this functions as both a review, and also a mini instruction manual on how to play the game since D&DG does not guide you in the slightest.

Oh one final tip: Be ok with small losses. Example: Your opponent is at 18 and you are at 13. Currently if you stand, you take 5 damage. Now you can Hit and maybe you get a 6-8 and end up beating your opponent by a few points and that's cool sure... but if you go bust, you are taking 18 damage... you have 100 health in total, so you cannot take these risks regularly. Accept small losses, even in a row, and you will find greater success.

There's a lot bad with this one. First I'd like to say that I gave this game a shot multiple times, I've 100% it twice and both times were mind numbingly boring. I absolutely love the first game, enough to make me speedrun it from time to time. So I was absolutely excited when they announced a second game. I've never been so disappointed in my life before. In Subnautica Below Standard, they offer more bad then actual good in terms of both gameplay and story. Which really felt like a step back for the series' direction considering how amazing the first game was. First. I'll talk about the good segments. The atmosphere, plants and scenery were all very good, all were very polished and you can see care went into into this part specifically. Now that we're done with all the good parts in this game and the only saving grace, lets talk about the bad parts of this game, and boy is there a lot.

First, the map. The map in this game feels so much more smaller and enclosed (because it is) when compared to the first game. Instead of having that really amazing feeling of getting lost and actually enjoy traveling like in the first game, you get a very watered down variant of it. Areas are a lot more small, less dangerous, and not as engaging as the first game. All the areas that were abandoned are all pretty small as well so you don't get that same feeling of trying to figure out what happened to the people that were there before. Traveling from place to place feels more like a chore then anything, there's zero danger in the waters and the violent fish are nothing more then a mere inconvenience to get through. Finally you're left with the surface segments. God they're so boring and the only slightly "exciting" thing is the huge worm that follows you. The actual places you can visit on the surface are also pretty lackluster. They offer really nothing other then a few key items and like a few novelties to decorate your base with. The worm is stupid easy to avoid, he does minimal damage so its not even a threat, and even if he was you cant even kill the dude. With the first game if you wanted a leviathan dead you could knife it to death or use a prawn suit, which was actually a really fun challenge to do. In Below Standard, you cant even hurt the worms because... well you're never really given a reason other then "they have thick shells" (which if you think about it, the prawn's drill can mine freaking diamonds, why the hell wouldn't it be able to drill the shell of a giant gummy worm.) 

Second, how the actual gameplay was implemented feels like if the devs taking a test 120 minute test with only 5 minutes left, did absolute zero work and didn't know the answers. So they copied the dude 4 seats ahead of them because they needed to write something down really quickly. Firstly all the materials you find in this game are either stupid easy to get, or really annoying to get. Which yeah you may think that's just normal game design but they made all the commonly used materials annoying to find, and the endgame stuff stupid easy to get. The first game at least had a way to get a lot of copper and quarts pretty easily, while in this one i had to go to 2 biomes over just to get a small handful. The seatruck is a mix of the seamoth and the cyclop in the first game. I loved those two vehicles a lot but they somehow managed to get only the annoying things from those two, and put them into a single vehicle that's supposed to be your main source of transportation. The seatruck is pretty annoying to control, all of its segments are for specific uses so you cant even make it semi custom like in the cyclops.  Its also stupid slow too and often feels slower then using a seaglide just to get around. The other vehicle I used so rarely that I cant even remember it's name but its the hover bike that's in the screenshots. First, about that bike is that its stupid slow. So slow you cant even use it for the main thing it's designed to do, which is outrun and dodge the unkillable worms. When I played, I often had my bike get destroyed whenever the worm would poke its head out, roughly 20 meters away from me, which would kick me off of it instead of letting me outrun it. There is an upgrade from what I remember to make it *kinda* faster but that can be solved with what I mainly did, which was just using the prawn suit. They kept the prawnsuit in the game which meant you now have a proper way to travel both in the water, and on land. Which makes both the seatruck and bike totally useless. Sure you can get the other ones before the prawn suit but like, you'll never use them ever again after you get the prawn. At least with the cyclops you could bring it to the active lava zone without needing a prawnsuit to do anything down there. Oh also the prawnsuit is faster then both the seatruck and the bike, meaning its completely useless to use either in any situation, other then the prawn being too tall for some cave systems. 

Third, is probably one of the most important parts of any game, The story. My god is it such a HUGE step down from the first game. The story is you basically purposefully crash on an island to find your sister (who you already know is probably dead) to go find out what happened. Then you met a predecessor who invades your mind in the most obvious and uninteresting way. You then have to build the predecessor a body so then you can get him out of your head, so then you can finish the story. Which yeah that's can be a totally fine story, but how they execute it is awful. Firstly, Robin, the girl you play as is the most annoying character ever made. All her interactions with other characters just made me hate Robin more and more instead of wanted to see what her story was about. Not only that but she has pretty much zero character development. Second how they handled the infection was absolutely terrible. In the first game its really well polished with how they handle everything with it. In this one they kinda just make you combine a plant and if i remember correctly some salt and it cures the infection. So you're telling me that an infection that almost wiped out an entire plant could have been cured with some freaking fruits? Common fruits at that, that grew not even 100 meters away from the damn thing? Seriously, either they hired new writers who ruined the IP like with the halo show, or the devs were high on deepshrooms. The story regarding her sister was so bad I can even remember what it was about. I just remember she was dating someone and Altra didn't like the sister for whatever reason. I could be wrong with this part specifically so take that with a grain of salt, the story was hard to stay awake in. Finally you have the interactions with that old lady, they were the only decent thing in the story. Mainly since she had a cool dog but that was the only cool thing about her.  Honestly I don't really like saying this but Robin felt like a complete "Mary Sue", everything she does it feels like the devs were trying to make her one up the past MC. She feels like if the Forespoken devs were quickly asked to make a main character, and all that they had was a napkin. After making the draft they didn't like it so then they threw it away, then Unknown Worlds picked it up and used it for Robin character design. SO. I will start by saying I enjoyed the first Outer Worlds despite the shortcomings. I didn't consider it nearly on the level of FNV, and I considered it a neat AA experience

It's impossible to talk about this sequel without comparing it to the first game and/or FNV. I mean if you're reading reviews that's probably what you're trying to find out so here's my thoughts after like 20 hours:

----------------

1) RPG Mechanics //
The RPG mechanics are miles better than TOW1, and honestly even FNV.

You actually have to choose specializations in your skills. You CANNOT be a jack of all trades, and you cannot max every skill so that you pass every skillcheck, especially late game skillchecks which require really high points in specific skills

THAT BEING SAID, there are also traits (and even flaws and backgrounds) which come up in speech often. So even if you can't pass a skillcheck, sometimes you can just use your lucky trait, or dumb/sickly flaw, or your background as an ex convict or professor or whatever to pass those checks instead. 

So yeah. Hot take but it's better than FNV in this area.

----------------

2) World(s) and Worldbuilding //

I like space. I like sci-fi. I like space sci-fi. If you don't like these things.. well why are you even considering this game lol.

I liked the charm of TOW1 but it felt like the areas were way too small, uninteresting, or just otherwise streamlined. This game is a complete upgrade on all of those aspects.

The scope is huge, the factions are actually interesting, and the areas are cool. 

----------------

3) Gameplay, Gunplay, Writing, and Dialogue //

Absolutely amazing. It plays smooth, the guns are FUN. The writing is fun. The dialogue is hilarious.

TOW1 had some funny moments in dialogue and writing, but honestly this is 1000% better. Some of these scenarios and characters you come across will just have you laughing -- and I really have no idea how they came up with some of them but it's great and I'm totally here for it lmao. I would give details but it's better to just go in blind and experience it firsthand for yourself.

----------------

4) WHAT ELSE?? //
I don't know what else to put in this review. Do you really care about graphics if you're considering a bethesda/obsidian RPG? If so they're better than any of the others I've played. Are they cyberpunk77 graphics, or KCD2? No. But they're good. And honestly some of the dialogue facial animations are on the level of those games and feel way less stiff than TOW1

Did I mention this game is fun?? Now be a good consumer and buy it.

If I had one word to describe this game then it would be "slick". 

Slick 
• controls
• visuals
• gameplay
• narrative
• presentation
• performance

Took me 7.8 hours to finish the campaign on "Brutal" difficulty. Personally, I am unbothered by the campaign length since I enjoyed every second of it. I'd rather experience 7-8 hours of pure fun rather than 20-30 hours of padded, repetitive and bland content only sprinkled with some fun here and there. And if I want more hours I will replay the game once NG+ mode is fixed and re-released.

Major props to the designers who balanced the game as having completed the game on Brutal, I'd say the experience never felt unfair. No cheap deaths or unfair encounters. If I died then it was because of my own fault and not some stupid decision of a sadistic designer. Encounters have adequate space and enemy variety to give each weapon their moment to shine. Speaking of the weapons, I did not find any weapon overpower the whole weapon roster. The alternate fire modes and different upgrades add to each weapons identity and functionality. I always rotate them during firefights especially later ones which require the usage of your whole arsenal to win. It's one aspect I think Metal Eden does better than DOOM The Dark Ages where you can beat the game with only one weapon.

The levels aren't labyrinthine, abstract messes or wide, empty boxes. Each arena could be a standout deathmatch map in Unreal Tournament or Quake. Besides the arenas, there is also outdoor environments where combat and exploration take place, there are parkour and high speed areas where you ride zip lines and sometimes swap on different lines while fighting enemies. For those who like to explore then there are secrets here and there in the levels although don't expect any crazy secrets or easter eggs. Secrets will lead to extra resources to upgrade your suit or weapons or an extra life pickup.

With an RX 9070 XT and 9800X3D I can easily get 120-150+ FPS at 3440x1440 on High settings and maxed out textures on Nobara Linux. Did not encounter any stutters or hitching during gameplay either and the loading is very fast.

The asking price of RM 125.90($29.83 as of October 2025) is fair to me considering whats on offer here. A fully voiced campaign with pre-rendered cinematics, AAA graphics and polish with AA pricing, 0 game breaking bugs and excellent performance on Linux.

Buy now if you want a solid AA FPS that is not just another boomer shooter with lo-fi graphics. Buy on sale if you're short on cash.

Codename CURE ist ein gratis Coop first person shooter in dem 4 Spieler gegen Horden von Zombies antreten müssen. Ich hab das Spiel zum ersten mal letztes Jahr mit einem Kollegen gespielt und möchte in dieser "Review" über die guten sowie schlechten dinge und die Entwicklung des Spiels im vergangenem Jahr berichten.



--ABLAUF--
Zu beginn jeder Mission wählt man sich eine von 5 Klasses, welche Waffenwahl sowie Item bestimmt (zu dem Klassen komme ich später wieder). Dann besteht jede Mission daraus einem bestimmten Punkt im Level zu erreichen und eine Bombe zu platzieren. 
Auf dem Weg durch das Level kämpft man sich durch massen von Zombies, außerdem gibt es hin und wieder Hindernisse (welche vergleichbar mit Left 4 deads "Crescendo Events" sind). in diesen muss man oft vor einer Tür die sich (viel zu) langsam  öffnet warten und sich gegen unendlich spawnenede Gegner wehren.
Ist das Ziel erreicht und die Bombe platziert, muss man innerhalb einer bestimmten Zeit wieder zurück zum Anfang, dies geschieht entweder direkt per backtracking oder per andere vorgegebe Routen.



--GAMEPLAY--
wie vorhin erwähnt wählt man zu beginn jeder Mission eine von 5 Klassen aus, diese sind wie folgt:
-Pointman, dieser hat eine Automatikschrotflinte als Primärwaffe und eine Granate als "Item".
-Support, hat eine Maschienenpistole und verteilt Munitionskisten (welche den Weg der Zombies blockieren)
-Assault, hat ein Sturmgewehr (welches aus CSS gerippt wurde und besitzt eine Granate (wie der Pointman).
-Technician, welcher eine Schrotflinte hat und eine Sentry aus Half-life 2 platzieren kann.
-Sniper, der Sniper hat eine Sniper.
Wie man sieht ist jede Klasse außer dem Support und dem Technician nutzlos, da Sie dem Team
wenig nützen und nur Granaten werfen können.
Man kann jetzt zu ihrer Verteidigung sagen, dass diese dafür da sind um Schaden zu machen 
allerdings führt mich das schon zum nächsten Problem von Codename CURE:
es gibt KEINE Coop Elemente bzw. spielerische Interaktion (sofern man friendly fire nicht mitzählt), es gibt keine möglichkeit teammates zu heilen,  ist die HP auf null ist man tot (und man muss bis zum Ende spectaten), Feinde kann man nicht markieren, man kann Teammates welche nur noch Humpeln können (weil ihre HP niedrig ist) nicht mitziehen, man kann sich  gegenseitig nicht boosten um an höher gelegene Stellen zu gelangen.

Es gibt nichtmal Spezielle Gegner welche den Spieler festhalten bis ein anderer in befreit.
Die Zombies hier sind die Half life 2 citizen dessen model verändert wurde und mit den animationen der headcrab zombies versehen wurde. Ich weiß, dass es sich um ein gratis Spiel handelt und um ehrlich zu sein finde ich es nichtmal so schlimm, was mich aber sehr stört, ist dass die Zombies exact die selben Stats haben, wodurch die Zombies viel zu viel  HP haben als, dass man sich effektiv gegen horden wehren kann, man ballert sein ganzes Magazin hirnlos in einen Zombie und hofft, dass dieser umkippt bevor er den Spieler erreicht.
Es gibt zwar einen Nahkampf instant kill move, aber um einen Gegner damit zu töten ohne Schaden zu ist reine glückssache, weil die Nahkampf range der Gegner größer ist als der Spieler (fragt nicht wieso).
durch diese Kleinigkeiten wurde effektiv Skill aus dem Spiel entfernt.BRAVO.
Außerdem spawnen die Zombies wirklich überall im Level, man kann einen Raum vor den Horden halten bis die Zombies aufeinmal direkt in dem Raum Spawnen in dem man sich befinden, von sowas zu Sterben macht keinen Spaß und schraubt den Frustfraktor noch höher als er ohnehin schon ist.

kommen wir zu den Waffen,  diese sind reine Standard kost, kein Rückstoß, es gibt Iron sights und die Waffen laden schnell nach. Diese zu benutzen macht keinen spaß, da sie sich sehr schwach anfühlen (Gegner haben zuviel HP, es gibt keinen Rückstoß, Gegner reagieren nicht darauf wo man sie trifft usw.), es hätte erheblich geholfen wenn Kopfschüsse instant kills gewesen währen, da 1. sich cool fühlt wenn man viele headhsots verteilt und 2.bei mehreren Gegner auf einmal die Ruhe bewahren müsste um am leben zu bleiben.



--ENTWICKLUNG--
da dies ein early acces Spiel ist hoffte ich leztzes, dass die Entwickler weiter an ihrem Produkt schrauben würden, und das taten Sie.
Die Levle wurden stark überarbeitet und shen ziemlich gut aus, Zombie Animationen wurden verbssert und es gibt skins.
Das wars. Sonst ist das Spiel gleich geblieben. Keine neuen feautures, das Gameplay wurde nicht verbessert.
Dies ist der Grund warum ich diese Review verfasse, da ich die Hoffnung verloren habe, dass aus diesem Spiel noch etwas gutes wird. Die Entwickler scheinen nicht zu verstehen was ein COOP Spiel ist und ihnen sind map remakes und "skins" wichtiger als gutes gameplay.

FAZIT:
es unterhalt für 5 min, dann merkt man, dass es eigentlich kein coop spiel ist und ehe man sich versieht hat man durch alle missionen innerhalb 1 vllt 2 Stunden gespielt.
Mein Rat: spielt Gmod und spawnt einfach viele Zombies auf Big CIty.

Early Access review:   MIXED review.  I'm willing to re-review this game if the issues below are addressed and fixed.

Is the game worth playing right now:  Kinda... and be prepared to be frustrated.  I found it was only playable for about 20 hours tops.  

Is the game worth buying?  NO.  One reason I say NO is because this game has been in Early access for what 4-5 years now?  This game still suffers from basic game mechanic issues at this point, preventing players from progressing.  would have expected, after 4 years of development to see those issues long gone.  Which means, this game will most likely never reach it's full potential.  

Here's my advice,
1. The screen shots of all the advanced things, nice, but players will never progress that far because they will quit long before then.  Mainly due to obtuse game mechanics.
2. This game has lists of input and outputs for everything and it's confusing.  I get it's easy to program, but a scroll-able graphic, like a flow diagram would make things crystal clear.
3. Oxygen... I have all kinds of machines making oxygen and still can't fill one bottle per week, which means you slowly suffocate and eventually die. Something is broken here.
4. The map interface for managing pins, very clunky.  Especially when trying to type the text for the pin.
5. Food plots, is it empty or just a small plant?  Player should be able to walk up and see instantly if a plot is planted and if the plant is in distress (dying) or healthy (growing).  Right now we have to hover over 50 different plots every time.
6. Salvage structures randomly disappear.  Found a nice spot to salvage, away from home, so I set up a temp base, was breaking it down, slept for the night, and then the building disappeared, except for a few scattered crates.  LOL.  or maybe the aliens got it behind my back.  ;)  
7. CO2 scrubber... it's broken and no one knows how to make it work, not even the directions.  All it does is suffocate you or blow up.  Maybe a graphic like a flow diagram with input/outputs could help.  not sure what you're trying to do with this thing.
8. Because of the inability to refill an oxygen bottle with any of the machines, mainly because the production volumes are too low or non existent.  Caps the fun level of this game.
9. Oxygen inside structure isn't obvious and it broken.  Is there breathable oxygen?  How knows, the indicator isn't working properly.  I can take the helmet off and work there forever, never suffocating.  But take a nap, you wake up and instantly suffocate.  Many issues like this, I'd say, the game mechanic is definitely broken.  Really?  after all these years of development and this particular mech isn't working?  And thus the main reason for my review.

If you want to make money on this game, I would fix these issues right away or you risk losing interest of the players.  There are other games out there that don't have these issues.

En primera instancia, Injustice 2 representa un excelente trabajo por parte de sus desarrolladores. La mecánica es similar a la de otros videojuegos de pelea como Mortal Kombat (no en vano, ambos comparten estudio), e incluso cuenta con la aparición de personajes invitados como Sub-Zero y Raiden. Los modos de juego son sencillos e interesantes; algunos personajes están mejor equilibrados que otros, pero ese es precisamente parte del reto. Cada luchador tiene su propio estilo, movimientos y “trucos” que lo diferencian.

En cuanto al modo multijugador, actualmente es bastante difícil jugar en línea: la comunidad activa se ha reducido a menos de mil usuarios aproximadamente, lo que complica encontrar partidas. Fuera de ese detalle, el resto de los modos funciona perfectamente. Las secciones “Multiverso” y “Gremio” ofrecen misiones variadas (algunas más desafiantes que otras) que mantienen el interés y permiten seguir disfrutando del título sin necesidad de jugar en línea.

El comportamiento de la inteligencia artificial (IA) es algo irregular. Su dificultad resulta difícil de entender: al principio, jugar en el nivel más alto parece sencillo, pero con el tiempo se vuelve mucho más complicado. Los rivales cambian constantemente sus estrategias y combos, lo cual puede ser frustrante, aunque también aporta un toque de realismo.

A nivel gráfico, el juego cumple y supera en varios aspectos a su entrega anterior. Sin embargo, no todo es perfecto: algunos escenarios presentan problemas de optimización, incluso en equipos que cumplen con los requisitos recomendados. Aun así, el apartado visual es sólido y los efectos de iluminación, los detalles de los trajes y las animaciones son destacables.

La sección de bóvedas y modificaciones de skins es, sin duda, uno de los puntos fuertes. Cada personaje cuenta con al menos diez variantes de color, además de la posibilidad de personalizar rostro, torso, piernas y brazos. También se pueden modificar poderes y habilidades, lo que añade profundidad y variedad al juego.

En cuanto a la historia, deja un sabor agridulce. Existen dos líneas narrativas (una centrada en Batman y otra en Superman) y personalmente espero (y quiero creer) que la de Batman sea la canónica. A lo largo de la campaña se puede jugar con la mayoría de los personajes, lo que es interesante, y además permite elegir entre distintas rutas. Para obtener el 100% de progreso es necesario repetir varios escenarios con diferentes personajes, lo cual puede ser tedioso, aunque vale la pena hasta cierto punto.

Respecto al desarrollo narrativo, considero que Superman es el punto más débil. Su historia lo retrata como un personaje pobremente construido, con motivaciones egoístas y un comportamiento casi absurdo; un villano mediocre más que un héroe corrompido. Sus seguidores, por ende, se sienten igual de vacíos y sin propósito claro. En cambio, la historia de Batman es más coherente y fiel al personaje que se conoce en los cómics y las películas: refleja muy bien su esencia, aunque podría estar mejor desarrollada. Aun así, Injustice: Gods Among Us (la primera entrega) tiene una historia mucho más sólida.

Sobre el precio, Injustice 2 es una verdadera ganga: por apenas 2,50 USD se obtiene el juego completo con todos los personajes y DLCs incluidos. Teniendo en cuenta la cantidad de contenido y las horas que puede ofrecer, lo vale absolutamente. Además, cada personaje tiene su propia mini historia dentro del modo Multiverso, lo que añade contexto y profundidad al universo del juego. En este aspecto supera a Mortal Kombat, siendo más económico y ofreciendo una experiencia más accesible.

El villano principal, Brainiac, es un acierto. Eleva el nivel de amenaza y funciona como antagonista central de forma convincente. Aun así, se extraña la presencia del Joker o de figuras icónicas como Lex Luthor o Darkseid, que habrían aportado más variedad al conflicto. En cambio, personajes como Gorilla Grodd resultan algo irrelevantes dentro de la narrativa (honestamente, para eso mejor ver El planeta de los simios).

En líneas generales, y desde mi humilde opinión, Injustice 2 lo vale. Es un juego muy completo, sólido en su jugabilidad y con un sistema de combate que engancha. Su punto débil es la historia (especialmente la de Superman, difícil de comprender y mal estructurada), pero en todo lo demás cumple con creces. Le doy una calificación de 8/10: un juegazo que, pese a sus fallas, sigue siendo una de las mejores experiencias dentro del género de lucha moderna.

Раз уж контентная поддержка у Halo: Infinite завершается, выскажу ей напоследок свой респект.

Мультиплеер тут прекрасный: тем, кто с серией незнаком, окажется непривычным жонглирование между энергетическим и физическим уроном, но внутри Halo Infinite бьётся олдскульное пекарское сердце — никаких прокачек, сложносочинённых формул дамага, монструозных выкладок и персов с миллионом абилок. Ты — это то, что ты нашёл прямо в матче. Ты — это твой скилл и ничего больше.

Но при всей лаконичности в Infinite масса прикольных неочевидных механик: репульсор отбивает не только снаряды, но и технику, на вот этом странном револьвере не просто так висят два саблезубых лезвия, а пистолет офигенно добивает тех, кому не повезло оказаться рядом с вами без щитов. Крюк-кошка — ваще имба, которая не только тебя куда угодно закинет, но ещё и поможет тырить оружие или красть технику прямо в воздухе. Самый офигенный гаджет в игре!

Плюс мне нравится общий вайб Infinite: в меню играет слегка меланхоличный пост-рок, хэдшоты сопровождаются приятным хитмаркером, а общая картинка чистенькая, чёткая, без лишнего визуального мусора. Короче в игре просто прикольно находиться, стрелять и бегать.

При этом я не удивлён, что Infinite не взлетела: на старте у игры были гигансткие проблемы с гриндом заданий, свежий контент выходил со скрипом, а косметика тут попросту неинтересная — как-то не вдохновляет грызть мини-батл-пассы за заунывный шлем. Да и сингл звёзд с неба не хватал: он построен на тех же механиках, что и мультиплеер, поэтому стрелять попросту весело, но открытый мир совсем скудный, а сюжет — невнятный. Дааааа, очень нужно было в очередной раз обрывать историю предыдущей части, чтобы следующая игра серии, в свою очередь, забила на историю Infinite. Не сомневаюсь, что так и случится — с синглом у 343 вообще не склеивается.

А вот мультиплеер огонь — особенно если вы любите классику арена-шутеров типа Quake или Unreal Tournament. Тут нет тех же скоростей, но по духу, на мой взгляд, очень похоже — и лучшее, что сейчас есть из такого на рынке. Залетайте, пока народ не рассосался совсем.

I’ve played this entirely on a Steam Deck.

If you wish there was another Morrowind, Oblivion, or Skyrim, then this is probably the closest thing you can get.
It seems a bit more Oblivion-ish because it isn’t quite as overdone as Skyrim, and it’s also a bit more “old school” in the sense of not being too easy and dumbed down to attract a larger audience.

Technical implementation: I didn’t really have any performance problems but I was using a steam deck which is hardware the game is specifically targeted for. The only FPS problem happens when you summon 3-5 wolves. It seems like a problem specifically with wolves for some reason. Other people sometimes have problems but these are usually solvable by reducing 2 graphics settings like vegetation quality. The game is built using Unity but you can’t really tell when playing it.

Combat is a bit more difficult and action-oriented than Skyrim and Oblivion, though not complicated. The main thing is that you have dash (dodge), block, and parry as defensive options and parry rewards you for exact timing.

The design of the game mechanics seems pretty good and it seems like they addressed some of the weaknesses in Skyrim especially. Like in Skyrim you can get sneaking to the point where you’re practically invisible. In this game you can’t do that. Backstabbing is sometimes possible but not usually very practical. Sniping things with a bow from a distance can handle mobs maybe 80% of the time. (But beware that there are required “boss fights” where you are locked into an arena, so you have to be able to handle melee or short range combat.)

Unlike Skyrim, 2H (two-handed) weapons aren’t completely useless compared to just dual-wielding 1H weapons. You can parry and block with either loadout, and both equally prevent you from using a shield. Daggers have their own skill tree and are focused on speed; they’re not just some thing for extra backstab damage and they don’t usually give you a huge backstab advantage. (Generally speaking, the sneak attack damage bonus is about the same for all weapon types.) So all of this stuff is balanced out a lot better with no obviously useless or superior weapon types.

Magic is pretty simple and you don’t really have “schools” of magic other than summons vs direct damage spells. There are only four magic skill trees and the other two are wands/cubes (magic weapons) and a general tree for mana point bonuses and such.

Due to the lack of requirement for magic specialization, a ‘spellsword’ (referred to as a “battle mage” in the game) type character is more practical than usual.

There are still some weaknesses to the game which I think are mostly in the content;

- I think the game could use more side quests. There are a decent number, but only maybe 1/3rd of what Skyrim has, for example. (Skyrim is a bit overloaded with them compared to everything else though.)

- The character system is classless, but like similar systems you’re going to have to focus on two main skill strategies to be effective. This is fine, but there aren’t really any side quests dedicated to specific skill areas. Like there’s no “mage guild” or “assassin guild” or similar quest line that requires the use of certain skills to get associated rewards of some sort. The only ones kind of like this are for alchemy and crafting wyrdstone, but they’re rather underwhelming.

- Most of the “dungeons” seem too small and too few to me. The ones in Skyrim seem much bigger.

- The overland areas are divided into three maps instead of one big overland map. So it’s not really 100% open world. It’s more like 33% open until you unlock the next region, then it’s 66% open until you unlock the last region. This isn’t really that big of a deal though.

- The overall game scenario of “King Arthur needs to save Avalon” and such is a bit too closed to further expansion. It’s a bit difficult to imagine how a DLC for this game would work, and if I were developing a content add-on mod it would be difficult to fit anything into the narrow lore. Basically the world is too small and simple to allow for much creative expansion.

- There are a few awkward consistency errors. These are hard to entirely avoid where player choices make all permutations of choices hard to test, but they might have done better if they had some sort of dedicated continuity checker.

There are fewer bugs overall than the average Bethesda game.

So in short, this is not the “be all end all” FPS RPG and it doesn’t blow everything else away, but it’s pretty good given its limitations and I’d still recommend it even though I wish the world was bigger with more side quests and such.

战斗方面，闪避同赤痕自带后撤步，但本作加方向键可以向前闪避但前期不可穿过怪，后期加能力可穿，无碰撞伤害。战斗角色可切换三人，每人的武器有四种，且战斗中可随时更换，武器又有多种技能，所以战斗花样其实蛮多的，而且连击段数高伤害也高，喜欢搓招的玩家的话应该会喜欢，挺丝滑的。小怪攻击欲望不高，但擅长零帧起手，除了元素球以外无碰撞伤害，boss交互性差，全程上去输出到破韧接着继续输出就行，老实讲是个战斗宝宝巴士难度级别的游戏。

本作特色魔核可横向对比为赤痕的碎片，不同的是，魔核需要击杀怪物掉落，且需要类似古早rpg那种拼格子的方法安装的，但开武器格子这个设计很难恭维，因为本作难度低，大概率打完这个场景很快就能通下一个了，因此现在的武器开格子也没用，很快就会淘汰，直到结尾拿到最高级武器了才会有心情去开格子，结果在神居里的怪脆的很，魔核可生效的最高阶难度五也几乎是秒杀，只能说，数值设计问题很大。

地图设计比较差，很线性，且存在大量无意义绕路，捷径就是绕一大圈然后开个门这种，有些区域也过于空旷，下水道那个方块地图令人困惑，玩的又困又疑惑，而且大场景转场加载时间巨长（这点不知道是不是电脑原因）唯一有点意思的是尸鬼城地图，周围四个场景会和尸鬼城中间有一点联系，不过因为加载时间的问题导致我实际体感很烂。换房间刷新怪是恶魔城特色了，倒是方便刷道具，不算什么问题。

音乐美术剧情都还过得去，建模很过不去，地图里充满那种看着能站的地结果过去发现是背景，还有神秘卡头石头，人物建模可以说和个性一样棱角分明了。此外本作平台跳跃元素很少，解密较简单，以及一些彩蛋有点意思。总体来说无功无过吧，算心渊梦境同一档位。

I can't imagine why this has a mixed review, if you like Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night you will basically like Frontier Hunter. Stuff like the OST tracks being too short (and sometimes totally out of place), the menus feeling undercooked and the translation bordering very perilously close to Engrish don't effect the overall game, which has quite a lot going on, from crafting to novelty ship segments. 

Does it feel like whoever is behind this studio may have worked on Bloodstained and "borrowed" a copy of the engine for private use? Yes, but so what? There are a dire lack of Igavania games available in the first place, you won't catch me turning one that has this much effort put into it away.

Generally, PWS2 is solid. The innovations added to gameplay and the overall cleaning loop are immaculate, and I feel encouraged to use the entire spectrum of equipment I'm granted as opposed to just climbing the walls like a powerwashing chimpanzee.
I will go over the good and the bad - as good as this game is, there is some things I've noticed that need fixing.

THE GOOD
- Graphical fidelity. Dirt looks muckier than ever, and washing it off looks refreshing, satisfying, and leaves a shine on the proper surfacing, while leaving bright, saturated colors on things that don't shine as much. Cleaning cars is utterly beautiful; the metallic paint on the [spoiler]Car & Trailer[/spoiler] makes me cream.

- New equipment. Oh, hell, this is a livesaver. Scaffolding has a quick top-ladder, the scissor lift is a far better alternative to just jumping and spamming the long nozzle in the first game, and the Swirlforce floor brush can be a genuine lifesaver. Pro tip for the swirler; use the free cam and make circular motions with your mouse as you sweep the floor. It works wonders. Not to mention, the soap rework. Far, far better.

- Ulysses, Bubbles, and Squeak. Call me a Redditor, I don't care. Those 3 cats have my soul. I don't know where they found such good noises for the cats, but they're utterly adorable. Plus, you can pet them all! I have 3 orange beasts of my own, so the PWS LTD. cats remind me of them.

- Maps. The map design is immaculate, and features, yet again, a stunning variety of jobs to complete, from a simple moving van to a roller disco, and even onto [spoiler]the interior of the Ancient Temple you cleaned in the first PWS[/spoiler].

- UI. The menus are easy to navigate, and the overall HuD is nonintrusive and satisfying to look at, with multiple options for convenience and accessibility.

- The gameplay. It's PWS1, but improved. Washers feel more satisfying, spraying down dirty domiciles feels even more liberating, and getting a new washer, or equipment for it feels gratifying, and like you've accomplished something. The buy & sell feature helps with this tenfold.

THE BAD

- Multiplayer. There's no better way to say this. Multiplayer is fucked. Utterly fucked. You can't find lobbies. You can't join lobbies. You can't host lobbies. You can't invite your friends. Rough, rough playtesting for multiplayer was a necessity, and I don't believe it was tested thoroughly enough. I could be wrong, and this could be one of those cases of "this didn't pop up until we dropped the full", and I do hope this is the case, but as it stands, this looks untested. BE MINDFUL. AT THE TIME OF REVIEW, MULTIPLAYER IS BROKEN.

- General miscellaneous issues. Things I have a personal peeve against.
In-job text messages cannot be viewed anywhere, as far as I'm aware. This makes lore hard to follow if you have to tab out of the game during a text message, or if you're too distracted with washing a certain item. The lore is great, so this is a very bad thing.
You can't see the kind of material you're washing off of surfaces. This is an issue, because in the first game, being able to determine what you were blasting, and what your current washer did was a good way to gauge if you needed to either swap your nozzle to something more high-pressure, or outright purchase the next tier of washer. This was most adamant on the Vintage Car, where you had to blast rust off of the Cadillac with the red nozzle. This almost makes progression feel not worth the time and money spent, despite the obvious difference in power if you do compare the blasters.
Harper seems to be attached to your soul or some shit. Considering the other lore of PWS1 and 2, I'm willing to look past it, but the dude sees everything. Is there, like, a bodycam on me? I'm scared of Harper Shaw, man. Game over, man, game over!

That's all I have for now. Overall, I recommend this game wholeheartedly, but ONLY when they fix the multiplayer. Do not get it as is, and let FuturLab know that these issues NEED to be fixed. This game is at a bargain price - $25 USD for almost 45 hours of content - but the broken multiplayer gives it a very bad look.

If I missed any pros or cons, feel free to add on to them.

Скажу сразу, [b]KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue[/b] – это спорный, но важный сборник в истории, который хоть и выступает как пролог к [i]Kingdom Hearts III[/i], имеет очень важную роль в серии. Сборник состоит всего из трёх игр: [i]Dream Drop Distance HD[/i], [i]χ Back Cover[/i] и [i]0.2 Birth by Sleep – A Fragmentary Passage[/i], каждая из которых раскрывает вселенную настолько, что оставила огромный след в моём сердце.

[h1] KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD [/h1]
Удивительно, но перед нами полноценная игра, правда, изначально вышедшая на Nintendo 3DS, а теперь портированная на современные платформы с чуть подтянутой графикой и более-менее адекватным управлением. Геймплей, впрочем, остался таким же, каким он был в предыдущих частях серии, не считая одного нововведения – геймплейной механики «Flowmotion», которая даёт игроку возможность ходить по стенам, раскручиваться на фонарях (для прыжка) и кататься на перилах, как в серии игр про Соника, что задало особый вайб игре.

Сюжет завязан на Рику и Соре, которые проходят экзамен, чтобы стать мастерами ключа-клинка, путешествуя по мирам Дисней. Что из себя представляет этот экзамен нам уже говорили в [i]Birth by Sleep[/i], поэтому DDD сразу начинается с того, как ребята приступают к работе. Неожиданно, но в игре поднимаются темы взросления и личной ответственности. Играя за двух разных персонажей, мы посещаем одни и те же миры, видим одни и те же проблемы, но каждый из парней реагирует на ситуацию со своей стороны, от чего создаётся очень теплое ощущение в груди, что игрока наконец-то познакомили с главными героями серии поближе. [h1] KINGDOM HEARTS χ Back Cover [/h1]
Ну чтож, а дальше у нас по хронологии очередной интерактивный фильм примерно на час. Немного покопавшись в интернете и изучив зарубежные форумы, можно сказать, что [i]Kingdom Hearts χ[/i] – это серия из нескольких мобилок и браузерок, которые выходили под разными заголовками и распространены были, к сожалению, только в Японии, поэтому официально до нас дошёл только фильм, а также из неофициального – ролики на ютубе с прохождением и вырезками заставок.

Сюжетно же Kingdom Hearts χ представляет собой серию-предысторию всех событий игры. Фильм переносит нас во времена до войны ключей-клинков и знакомит с Мастером Мастеров и его учениками – провидцами, каждый из которых носит маску конкретного животного. Что-то вроде, характер персонажа = характер животного. В самом фильме нет никакого экшена или смысловой нагрузки – нам просто кратко рассказывают о том, что нужно знать о мобильной гаче, в которую мы никогда не сможем поиграть.

Но не буду врать, визуально – это один из лучших фильмов по Kingdom Hearts. Моё мнение – без контекста самих игр, данный фильм ничем не отличается от фильма [i]Re:coded[/i] из прошлого сборника. Я посчитала просмотр фильма обязательным для фаната серии, как атмосферный фрагмент он работает прекрасно, но вот в ином случае – очередной промах со стороны Square Enix.

[h1] KINGDOM HEARTS 0.2 Birth by Sleep – A Fragmentary Passage [/h1]
Очень короткая, но визуально впечатляющая игра – ожидаемо или нет, но, по сути, это пролог к [i]Kingdom Hearts III[/i]. Главная героиня, девушка Аква из [i]Birth by Sleep[/i], пытается выбраться из Мира Тьмы. Игра длится буквально часа 2-3, но выглядит невероятно шикарно – впервые игра переходит на движок Unreal Engine 4 и от этого каждый кадр и момент в игре хочется заскринить. Я бы никогда не поверила, что Kingdom Hearts может быть настолько невероятно красивой игрой.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3603743052

Геймплей представляет собой улучшенную и заметно ускоренную версию [i]Birth by Sleep[/i], с акцентом на комбо и применение магии. Вообще, чем-то даже напомнило DMC 5, никогда серия не была настолько динамичной и быстрой.

Несмотря на короткую продолжительность, сюжет оставляет эмоциональный след в груди. Одиночество Аквы, потеря лучшего друга, потеря любимого парня, её вера и борьба, и наконец, принятие судьбы. Я бы никогда не подумала, что RPG-игра так сможет зацепить сюжетом, завязанном на потере любимого человека. Отдельное спасибо за опенинг «Simple and Clean» в исполнении Hikaru Utada.

[h1] Итог [/h1]
Конечно, ввиду очередных трудностей портирования, назвать [b]KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue[/b] полноценным сборником довольно сложно, но как пролог к финалу серии он выглядит вполне себе приемлемо. Да, он не идеален, часть игр короткая, другую и вовсе не смогли портировать из-за того, что это онлайн-проекты, но в любом случае, даже с таким количеством игр, он всё равно ощущается важным в серии, без которого путешествие по миру Kingdom Hearts будет неполным. Особенно удивляет, насколько он передаёт «переход» от старой эпохи игр в новой.

· 小时候，最喜欢FSN线，因为中二的我觉得那条路笔直而明亮，正所谓“吾王剑锋所指，吾等心之所向”。 少年心中装得下整个世界，坚信“正义的伙伴”是世界上最酷的梦想，正如Saber执拗的骄傲与圣剑的光芒，完美契合了那个非黑即白的年纪——我们和卫宫士郎一样，眼里只看得到远方，尚不知回头凝视身边的代价。

· 长大后，经历了社会的毒打，明白了UBW线中的红A，因为我们都曾在现实的荆棘中撞得头破血流。 你终于发现，年少时的梦想只是一个会吞噬自身的空洞理想。那个未来，正是对“成长”最残酷的诠释：你并没有变成小时候想成为的英雄，而是看清了英雄背后的虚无与讽刺。但UBW的真正精髓，在于看清这一切后，士郎依然吼出“此身为剑所成”的瞬间——成熟并非向现实下跪，而是在认清其荒谬后，依然选择遵循内心的准则，并为之承担全部责任。

· 成家后，感悟到了HF线中只想守护一人的心情。 当生活具体为身边人的温度时，那种只想守护你的决心，不再是中二的口号，而是沉甸甸的责任。士郎为了樱一人而背弃“正义伙伴”的理想，这种“自私”恰恰是爱情与家庭最极致的体现——我终于明白，真正的强大，有时不是去拯救所有人，而是有勇气、也有能力去守护好那个对你而言，独一无二的“世界”。

重置版新增的路线图使得回溯方便不少，但因为是全年龄版本没有型月重工环节。本作于我有着不可替代的意义，否则我也不会变成fgo九年全勤的月丑，如今再去一条一条说其音乐，画面，剧情等也没什么意义，早被人说烂了，而且滤镜太厚无法做到客观评价。

总之强烈推荐，无论是补票还是新入坑都是首选，再不济就当给20年前的蘑菇烧纸了，总比充到fgo里抽一堆绿方块要好。

There are people called "paper architects", people with great visions of awesome buildings, architectural fantasies, that have never been built. The digital age allows us to go a step futher and explore architectural fever dreams that are not bound by the limitations of our eurclidian world. This is undoubtably the greatest strength of Manifold Garden.

On top of that, you get a first person puzzle game that is not very challenging but is rather unique and keeps you engaged for the duration of the journey. It could have been a little harder for my liking, but I have the feeling the engine allows to very easily or even inadvertently make fiendishly difficult and confusing puzzles, so the devs showed some very commendable restraint in their design.

Of note, the Intense visuals and intense music culminate in one of the most memorable ending to any video game ever.

TL;DR, A great game in the first half that sadly fails to stick the landing. 
SPOILERS AHEAD. 

I love the idea of Horror RPGs, it's such an untapped market compared to the oceans of fantasy and scifi titles out there. When I saw the game was going for a kind of H.P. Lovecraft/Robert E Howard feeling horror-fantasy, I had hope that the game would deliver. And for the first half, it absolutely did.  
However, once you get your sailboat, it all goes downhill. Suddenly, the game isn't about your character anymore, but Embla, who asserts herself as the main character despite not being in the game for at least half the play-time. 
Then you're fighting your way through a mine full of Deep Ones, and up until this point you've been positively stacking non-euclidian corpses left, right, and center. But if you try to fight the queen head-on, it's instant death. So you have to do a poorly designed and even more poorly explained puzzle to kill her in the least fun way possible. But the Ludonarrative dissonance doesn't stop there! 

Suddenly, you're fighting a giant worm who you handily defeat because your party is a squad of wizards and warriors sporting magic weapons and spells that shred its health in two rounds until the game decides that No, the worm is acutally winning. 
"YOU MUST FLEE, IT IS TOO POWERFUL! I MUST SACRIFICE MYSELF TO HOLD IT OFF!"
"Actually we're not even hurt and I have potions out the-"
"FLEEEEE!! I MUST HURL MYSELF INTO THE BEASTS MAW TO SAVE YOU ALL!" 

Then the final act comes out of nowhere like a Hound of Tindalos and ham-fistedly kills off all your pre-made companions for no real reason in a practice that feels like the writer was trying to find increasingly elaborate ways to say "Rocks fall, everyone dies." 
And then the island you were trying to save explodes, making literally everything you did there entirely pointless. 
Yeah, sure, Lovecraftian narratives are all about postponing the inevitable, usually at great and terrible cost. But make me feel like I HAVE to make that choice. Put the gun in my hand and tell me that I NEED to shoot someone I care about. Darkest Dungeon does this quite well with the "Come Unto Your Maker" move in its final bossfight. 

You can't have your party tearing through swarms of various eldritch gribblies one moment, and then crumpling like tissue paper the next jusr because the Fish Mommy is Too Thicc. 
Pick a lane. Are we moths, inexorably drawn to an inevitable doom? Or a party of adventurers who can beat up a shoggoth and take its lunch money? The sudden "Rocks fall" ending feels almost tacked on, like the writer forgot they were supposed to be doing Lovecraft but then also forgot that some of Lovecraft's best stories involved eldritch beasties getting wrecked by boats, elephant guns, and one time literally just a normal-ass dog.

Initially I picked this game up and played for a little bit, maybe almost halfway through the game before I was distracted by other things, it was only recently I came back to finish and I'm glad I did.

If I could compare this game to another it'd be something like Baldur's Gate 3, what with turn based combat and skill checks, but using a different ruleset: a mana-type system instead of spell slots, having an action and movement system that is somewhat interchangeable with each other. For example some abilities may use your movement to use, instead of an action, so you're still able to cast/attack. Each class also gets it's own skill tree to put points in and unlock passives/abilities/spells, and it feels relatively balanced, though melee and archers seemed to have a slight edge.

Early on the game can be somewhat difficult, but as you get further in and are more well equipped/leveled, fights that seem awful at first glance can actually be quite tame, having one or two of the cleric archetype classes in your party for healing/buffs can help though if you're struggling.

Gameplay aside, the story really sucked me in, it has a eldritch horror theme to it that I don't see in a lot of games, and the pixel art they use for scenes are very well made, albeit gruesome at times. Avoiding spoilers, the ending was definitely unexpected, and for some I understand it can be unsatisfying, but it plays into the theme of everything you see throughout your adventure, so you can't expect everything to go right. 

Overall the game is great, my only wish is it was longer, but for an indie title at such a cheap price (even cheaper if on sale),  I highly recommend this to anyone that enjoys turn-based RPG's.

I really want to love this game. The character designs, the 3D models, the story, the concept are all so cute and sweet. It feels like the perfect game for me on the surface, but ultimately the issues come from what feels like a rookie development team. Maybe this is their first attempt at this sort of game, but there are so many small issues here which just make the game so hard to enjoy fully. This is going to be sort of long, and it's going to be a lot of negative feedback, but I need you, reader, to know, that I say this all out of love and a wish for improvement. I WOULD buy an Amber Isle 2 if they fixed these problems. I want to see these developers succeed.

My issues start with detection position. Interacting with things can be so finicky. You can be pressed up against something and it just won't let you interact unless you're wedged in against it awkwardly, effectively wasting like 5 seconds of desperately trying to wiggle into the right spot. It's very irritating.

You can also get stuck on objects, you can't fully access certain resource farming squares because the small bumps inside will body block you, making it so that you just can't make the most of it. Sometimes, if there's a mineable chunk of stone, you can get blocked from fully mining it halfway through. The hitbox of the stone blocks you from getting close enough to mine it. This means you have to loop around the stone to get to an angle where you CAN finish mining it. These issues are impossible to ignore, especially when you just want to open a shortcut for yourself later. This problem seems to pop up the most when you're on a slight incline.

I mentioned the 3D models, but there's a problem with them as well. The face morphs into really weird expressions sometimes. Some of the expressions are adorable, and others just seem lazily slapped together. Eyes will clip eyelids, the space around the eyes will fully obscure the eyes, which is especially bad with poor Malik and Harley. Two of my favourite Paleofolk! It sucks that I can't get cute screenshots of them without witnessing the horror of melting faces and phasing eyeballs.

You can't place objects on surfaces. If you want a small object in your shop, or in the wilderness, you just have to slap it on the ground. This sucks. I feel very restricted to only placing large objects, it makes no sense to see a random makeup compact on the floor. Chairs also have no interaction with tables, you can't tuck them in or anything, so if you want a little setup with some chairs and a table, the chairs have to be awkwardly about 3 feet from the table. It's just not very immersive, it doesn't encourage you to decorate by any means.

A positive towards decorating though is that you can place a lot of decorations close to others, you aren't necessarily inhibited by the physical shape of an object, just the squares which it consumes. This makes it easier to make gardens and things like that, it's not restrictive in that way, and that's nice.

Back to complaining, the menus are A Lot. Very clunky and excessive. If you want to place objects on your counters to sell, you have to go into a sub menu within another menu. There are also like 5 other sub menus for other functions, such as moving your counters, changing the flooring, changing the wallpaper, changing the windows, changing the doors, or just placing objects on the floor. This is like 5 or 6 clicks. It just feels sort of unnecessary and ineffective. This could be 3 categories.

With this in mind, I also wish that there was some way to search for specific items while speaking to a customer. I'll get asked for a bamboo item or a small item or something, and I don't always remember what items fit that criteria, I often have to look up the wiki and the wiki isn't much better in terms of ease of access. Some items look small, but they're actually medium. Some items look medium, but they're actually large. It would be so much more user friendly if there was just a little category selection option when you're offering items to customers, or a little search bar, or something to make it so that you don't have to alt tab for 10 minutes or else lose your streak.

I don't really understand why you can't craft or access your inventory or restock the store while the shop is open. You'll sometimes run out of stuff to sell while the store is open, and then you'll just start getting a heap of custom orders, which don't provide any immediate benefit, and can be sort of annoying when you just need some more money Right Now. No, Flint, I don't want to make 2 more stone shovels for your stone shovel collection, you just picked one up this morning. And then they act like I just kicked their dog!

I need to mention camera rotation. You can rotate your camera inside the store, but not when you're in the wilderness... Why? You can tilt it, but rotation is for some reason inhibited. Sometimes, especially in the swamp, you'll find yourself with your camera phasing into trees which canopy the area. You can't see jack when this happens unless you zoom all the way into your character, which is annoying, because then you can't see anything But your character.

Speaking of your character, I do genuinely love the character customization in this game. I wish that there were more clothing options, and I wish that you could change the colour of your fur tufts, but otherwise, the playable character is honestly very cute and the editing is so in depth. I love this part of the game, I could spend all day just creating little dinosaurs.

However, back around to bellyaching again, friendship scaling is off the charts. It goes up so very slowly, especially compared to regular game progression. I already have a 5 star shop, but no friends above friendship level 4, most are only friendship level 2 or 3 because I just can't be bothered grinding with everyone. On top of that, game progression is just a little strangely paced in general. As previously mentioned, 5 star shop, but I don't even have it at max upgrades or anything. I haven't finished the main story. I don't keep my store open that much, but I'm already at maximum as far as store quality can go, I guess. I was sort of confused by this, I thought it'd be tied to upgrading the shop at town hall, and now I don't really feel any motivation to improve my store. It's already perfect, right?

Thus concludes my yapfest. I wish I didn't have so much to moan about. I want to love this game so badly. I would adore to see a second installation with a little less jank and a little more understanding of the player's perspective. I will continue to play this game until I'm satisfied, but the whole time I'll be reminded of what could have been. It has so much potential.

I've been playing this game for little over an hour. Already I've experienced 2 glitches so severe I had to restart the game. This is beyond infuriating. I want to love this game, I really do. But why is the npc pathing so bad that they got stuck TWICE? 

The first happened when I interacted with the sales desk too fast during the shop open phase. No options showed up for the sale, however my character was put into the haggle screen. The npc wasn't even on screen. I had to hard stop the game from the steam page. 
The second also happened during the shop open phase, where two npc's got stuck inside each other on a sale table. There's really no excuse for this, especially considering the asking price for the game.

Aside from this, the E to interact is so finicky. You basically have to run into the object you want to interact with for it to work, despite the pop up happening at a few different angles. 说起来现实中我玩游戏的朋友还是太少了，这个游戏明明支持最多8人联机，结果一直是两个人玩。
个人感觉游戏的关卡设计堪称优秀
就像吃甜品一样。每个场景虽然看上去纷繁芜杂，一个接一个的物件摆设令人目不暇接，但实际上你总能快速发现关键道具，立即明白接下来要做什么。我和我一个朋友不仅通关了主线关卡和额外关卡，还一起玩了不少玩家自己制作的关卡，虽然自制关卡的时间长度和趣味性肯定比不上官方关卡，但是有几关仍然可以称得上"质量上乘"。比较喜欢"一起向未来"这关，果然中国人最懂如何逗乐中国人，疫情的深刻记忆点被一个接一个抖出，勾起了那段日子的回忆。转眼间人类一败涂地已经推出8年了，但现在依然保持着不小的热度，提到合作游戏，我们总能很快想到它。玩家与官方的携手共创，或许也是这个游戏经久不衰的原因之一吧。不过话说回来，都8年了！还不快点把你的第二部搬上来！快点公布发售日期！人类一败涂地有着"真实的物理引擎"，主角是无筋无骨的super面筋人，总能摆出各种奇怪的pose，一双哆啦A梦般的手万物皆可黏，还经常黏在脑门上弄不下来。作为合家欢游戏，本作没有"死亡"概念，摔出地图也无非就是从高空中再掉下来一次，玩起来没有任何负担，就算被门夹住只剩一个头在外面也完全没逝！
游戏的正常流程几乎没有难度，上手门槛是0
（除非你想学会爬墙），非常亲和。但是，游戏的全成就绝对称不上"轻松"。
当初的我：这游戏的成就要求也太阴间了，而且八成也没人和我一块做成就，还是不全成就了。现在的我：我要全成就。
一开始真的没有想全成就，所以没有查过成就攻略，加之自己的脑洞比较小，果然大多是的关卡基本上都只能拿到通关成就，如果想要补上这关的成就，这关无疑就要再打一遍甚至多遍。但我玩游戏很追求新鲜感，人类一败涂地的关卡又很简单，而且铁定没人愿意和我一起做全成就，所以很难有动力去打多遍玩过的关卡。
但我后面发现，我实在是小瞧了我的收集癖。大概是从"船坞"开始，我才开始注重关卡成就的收集，船坞是很靠后的关卡了，足以此见前面留了多少坑需要我慢慢填。
所以：
我独自再次来到了豪宅，爬上了火车，搬运了箱子，荡过了山峰，拆除了障碍，穿越了城堡，接通了电力，躲避了摆锤，冲破了黑暗，联通了蒸汽，融化了坚冰，然后发现自己没有从头至尾一次通关（成就全速前进的要求）。于是我又双聂叕来到了豪宅，爬上了火车，搬运了箱子，荡过
山峰，拆除了障碍，穿越了城堡，接通了电力，躲避了摆锤，冲破了黑暗，联通了蒸汽，融化了坚冰……
后面的额外梦境也基本上是重新打了一遍，好在游戏自带跳关指令，能缩减不少无趣的过程。做完全成就后，我已然成为爬塔高手（有个成就要求你40s爬完黑暗的钟塔）。

[h3] 📜 Кратко о сюжете: [/h3]
История в Chivalry 2 повествует о гражданской войне между рыцарями Агаты и орденом Мейсона (Мазона).
Орден Мазона был основан рыцарем Малриком, отколовшимся от Агаты и собравшим своих последователей вместе. 
Спустя время постоянные стычки между сторонами постепенно переросли в гражданскую войну, затроновшую все соседние поселения.
[h3] 🕹️ Геймплей: [/h3]
Геймплей представляет собой совокупность захвата и обороны крепостей, разрушения знамён противника и конечно же сражения с другими игроками.
Оружия имеются разные и нет тех, которые бы отрицательно влияли на баланс игры. Здесь есть многое: от меча с щитом до двуручного копья.
Атаковать можно с разбега, совершая комбинации ударов, прыгая с возвышенности или контратаковать и парировать каждую атаку противника. 
Атаки это хорошо, но стоит всегда помнить про полоску выносливости, ведь запас сил расходуют любые удары, вне зависимости от попадания или промаха.
Чтобы увеличить угол обзора можно сменить вид – перейти от первого лица к третьему, нажав соответствующую кнопку на клавиатуре.
За каждую победу на соперником вы будете получать опыт, который будет прокачивать вам основной уровень по окончанию каждого матча (можно посмотреть в главном меню в профиле), повышать уровень класса, а также открывать новое вооружение вместе с подклассами.

[h3] 🏰 Локации: [/h3]
Локации погружают в атмосферу настоящего средневековья. В игре присутствуют леса, замки, узкие городские улочки, корабли, деревни и различные частоколы и укрепления!
Здесь вы можете почувствовать себя в роли настоящего средневекового рыцаря-защитника или мятежника-захватчика, когда будете вести сражения на фоне какой-нибудь прекрасной крепости.
Отдельно хочу выделить интерактивность, ведь чтобы одержать победу можно и нужно использовать катапульты, баллисты, осадные башни, тараны и бочки с порохом. Также почти все предметы, лежащие на полках или на полу можно поднять и метнуть в противника. Это добавляет игре погружения и реализма, ведь в бою все средства хороши!
[h3] ⚔️ Мультиплеер и классы: [/h3]
С онлайном в игре всё стабильно. По крайней мере хватает для комфортной игры, несмотря на то, что порой встречаются игровые сессии с небольшим количеством игроков в популярных режимах.
Разнообразие есть как в выборе количества игроков, так и в выборе игрового режима. Присутствуют не только командные матчи, а ещё дуэли и режим каждый сам за себя.
От себя добавлю: не очень понравились масштабные бои (32 на 32 человека), так как в них решает в основном только количество союзников или противников в той или иной стычке, а не мастерство определённого игрока.
Итак, о классах...
Классы в игре имеются разные и у каждого из них есть подклассы:
[b] 1)Лучник [/b]
• Лучник с большим луком 
• Арбалетчик
• Воитель
[b] 2)Рыцарь [/b]
• Офицер 
• Страж 
• Крестоносец 
[b] 3)Авангард [/b]

[b] 4)Пехотинец [/b]
• Пикинёр

У каждого подкласса есть свои фиксированные умения, иногда они будут повторяться. Одни из них помогают поднять полоску здоровья себе и союзникам, другие позволяют нанести повышенный урон противнику, заблокировать путь или очень быстро пополнить боезапас.
Комбинируя атаки, знание классов и используя способности, можно добиться высоких результатов в матчах!
К слову, новичкам лучше не идти сразу в бой с игроками, а сначала потренироваться с ботами и более-менее освоить базовую боевую систему, тогда игровые сессии будут приносить только положительные эмоции и интересный игровой опыт.
[h3] 🏆 Достижения: [/h3]
Большинство достижений в игре выполнять интересно, но конечно же есть исключения. Имеются трофеи за победу на определённых картах, всего их четыре и для выполнения всех достижений потребуется победить на каждой по 25 раз!
Кстати говоря, можно всё упростить, настроив отдельную офлайн игру только с ботами. Данное действие значительно упростит выполнение этих достижений, как по времени, так и по затраченным силам.

I have a few mixed feelings about this game that all stem from how odd it is made. Supreme Commander 2 isn't really a bad game per say, it just feels like there is something missing wherever you look.

To start is the story. If you don't want a 15 year old game spoiled for you then play it yourself find out. [spoiler]Otherwise the gist is that the three factions are at war with each other for some reason and we play as three commanders who just so happen to have former ties to one another. One of them fights some Cybran thespian guy then fights his former command because they committed war crimes. Then the other commander unwittingly helps the same Cybran thespian in doing even more war crimes until he betrays her. Lastly is a Cybran who doesn't commit war crimes who fights the same Cybran thespian again after planet hopping and fighting his lackeys all the way to an ancient terraforming machine. The guy you play as wins and decides everyone is going to fight over it and blows it up all because he had a hunch.[/spoiler]

While the campaign isn't too much to handle there are moments when the game gives a lot more push than I think it should. Particularly with the first mission of the last campaign where you have to fight waves of enemies for a whole 30 minutes with very little resources and some bad path finding that can really screw you over when the end comes around. The third mission of the first can also be a bit of a pickle but not to the extent of that Cybran one.

As for the skirmish things have changed a fair bit from the last two games. Instead of making any strategy viable to each faction they are all different. UEF is arty heavy making them the turtle faction. Their tech tree is very fleshed out everywhere and arty is their best mode of attack with air in second and land coming up third. Cybrans are more of a rush faction, they can still turtle but that isn't what their tech is built for. Land air and naval are all viable for them to some degrees. Then there is the Illuminate or the Aeon as they are better called IMO. They are only built for the rush. They have the least amount of techs and no long range arty. They do have quite a lot of experimentals but these require a lot of research points and often times get out classed by the other two.

What I think went wrong is that the factions aren't created equal like in the original. In SupCom 1 or forged alliance everyone was relatively equal with notable differences in at least one or two units from every tech level and their experimentals. Another thing is that gameplay generally goes from slow to fast. When building up you are going slow and when the fight begins you go fast. Here everything is slow. Units take nearly half a minute to build on their own. They move slow without the necessary upgrades to speed them up. It's not the unit's fault it is as slow as it is but more so the fact that it is designed to be that way. Also the maps are quite big so that might not help much either. Another thing is that experimentals, while strong don't stack up on their own. In the original they needed a big army/air force to take down, here however they are easy pickings for decently sized groups. In larger numbers they can prove powerful but otherwise are entirely optional to build.

All in all I can say if you really want to play the game go ahead. Also if you bought the DLC like I did make sure to turn it on if your game crashes for no reason. That does fix it but it also turns the AI into a ruthless killing machine if you don't fight back. All in all 7/10 A flawed but relatively decent game worth at least a few hours of gameplay.

(8/38 succès en 7h, reçu en cadeau d'un proche, jouable entièrement à la souris)
Imaginez Balatro avec des tuiles de mahjong. Et en plus pas besoin de savoir jouer au mahjong. 
Oui parce que j'aimerais bien savoir jouer au vrai mahjong chinois ou japonais, il y en a d'ailleurs vous le savez dans la série Yakuza, mais c'est très difficile.

A l'inverse ici c'est simplissime. Vous piochez des tuiles aléatoires, les vraies du mahjong avec lesquelles vous avez peut-être déjà joué en solitaire : cercles, bambous, caractères, vents et dragons. Et vous posez soit une suite + une paire. Par exemple 234 77. Ou alors 3 tuiles identiques + une paire : 222 66. Ou 4 tuiles identiques + une paire. 3333 99. Au fil des 4 tours, ce que vous avez posé reste et s'accumule dans le décompte. Sauf la paire, toujours la dernière posée, qui sert de multiplicateur.
L'ensemble des tuiles posées forme un pattern, qui sert également de multiplicateur selon sa rareté pour le décompte. Exemple de pattern légendaire : 444 555 666 777 88  

Bon évidemment vous pouvez améliorer vos multiplicateurs et récupérer des objets plus ou moins rares pour aider encore plus. Ou encore piocher ou détruire de nouvelles tuiles, en altérer avec de nouvelles matières ou couleurs.
Tout ça c'est bien sympa, ça se fait d'ailleurs très naturellement, et c'est très nécessaire face aux boss avec leurs vilaines exigences. Exemple : un boss qui détruit vos tuiles si votre paire contient des chiffres entre 2 et 8. Vous voyez le genre.
La musique est de style extrême-orientale, répétitive mais très relaxante. Non scénarisé. Manque peut-être un peu de variétés de décors de fond (là c'est très sobre, reposant mais ça ne fait pas vraiment rêver) ou de tuiles, mais c'est en early.

Après avoir gagné ma 1ère partie en 7h, c'est le genre de jeu qui se cale bien entre 2 autres jeux plus prenants ou quand on a la flemme. Perso avec beaucoup d'autres jeux à finir, c'est plus le temps qui me manque pour y rejouer que l'envie. Mais une partie de temps en temps, ce serait volontiers.

[h1]游玩建议[/h1]
1、自动保存，没有回头路，建议第一时间去指南区抄作业（非常详尽！）少走弯路，以及先记好哪些支线送属性点。
2、升级送的技能点全加在只耗1点的主属性上，耗3点的非主力属性去任意城堡用金币升级，不然很亏。没多少装备值得买，也没别的开销，大方把钱花在提升属性上吧。
3、前期等级太低，攻城很吃力，没必要死磕，做一轮任务回来就轻松多了，晚一点没多少损失。
4、尽早入手狼或狮鹫当坐骑，不仅移动速度最快，还能提供元素加成，唯一缺点是技能完全没用。理论上可以多训练一两只技能好用的慢速坐骑专门拿来打boss，但每只都要在城堡玩三消训练老半天，太累了。只要坐骑等级够高，就能回避路上随机刷的杂兵战，差评区不少人没发现这点。
5、俘虏应抓尽抓，但除非想做法术全收集成就，不然没必要硬着头皮玩，玩法最耗时间却几乎没收益（我全学了，结果没一个好用。唯一本该在前期很实用的“再生”因为bug变废物技能）。
6、记得根据boss特性换装备。例如东南角的瘟疫王，叠多层瘟疫debuff导致法力条总是空的，不装备之前任务送的“治疗魔典”没法玩，估计也比较适配炸弹流。
7、队友的作用是根据不同敌人种族属性触发buff，频繁程度大致和戏份多少成正比，所以最实用常驻的是鳏夫卓尔猎人、矮人工程师、牛头人萨满，其他根据当地敌人种类灵活替换。


[h1]51.5小时元素师全程困难难度一周目体验[/h1]
1、玩法
（1）尽量第一时间开每回合增加少量四元素法力的buff，可根据盘面情况推延一两回合。
（2）四元素差不多堆满后，化身无情射箭机：
前2/3流程的1阶段技能就是每次打10~20点刮痧，燃费低到可以忽略不计；
45级解锁的2阶段变成耗光一整管打出等值伤害，已经是质变；
50级解锁的3阶段腾飞，无需重新装填，在“希望”buff和充能装备加持下，几乎可以不停连射，每箭50多。

2、必须尽快入手的装备
（1）棱镜护甲：每次获取法力都有不低的概率提升对应元素抗性，对付越强的敌人越有用。
（2）自行锻造的“XX眼”：每次敌人施法都给你四元素各充5点，加上“希望”buff就翻倍。
（3）血石头盔：获取火元素法力时也能顺便加土和水，提高效率。跟前两个比有点鸡肋，平时打杂兵都换成了双倍经验的徽章。
（4）盗贼头巾+变色龙戒指：全职业全时期通用的炸弹流装备，魔法不好使的时候有大用。

3、最终boss战充分展现该职业的长短处
（1）唯一一次必须带“混沌之墙”的恶战，否则扛不过前期对方的炸弹连炸。
（2）即使残血也能用几发“自然冲击”奶回来。
（3）棱镜护甲堆高我方魔抗后，敌方不停施法非但不会伤到我方，反而成了永动机充电宝。
（4）Boss魔抗字面上写着42%左右，实则体感98%左右，双方无限互相miss，愣是磨了差不多一小时，早知就该把金币梭哈给物理攻击力、换炸弹流装备。

4、瞄了眼差评区，发现我算是玩得好的，平时有注意尽量避免让敌人拿到四五消，关键是整套BD都很稳健，容错空间大，不太会被敌人的运气气炸。

Story wise starts immediately after first one. Journalist character from FMF1 is nowhere to be seen, probably killed off screen. Beautiful graphics, even more detailed than in its predecessor. Excellent, creative, and outright gnarly alien weapon animations.

Many of my issues from the first game were fixed. Manual saving. Much better translation and voice acting. It's more ambitious. Levels are open and complex, though do not fall into being overly complicated; full freedom of movement: very few invisible walls, can jump nearly anywhere. A few misses: Desert Shrine is an Egyptian map with dark mazes and a switch hunt, and Nightmare World looks great, but is a visual noise and enemies and pickups are blending with the background.

While FMF2 fixed many problems from FMF1, another one reared its ugly head: balancing. On Normal the game is fairly easy throughout, but has multiple difficulty spikes in the form of arena battles. The main character moves slower than in FMF1 and doesn’t have any movement abilities whatsoever, while being bombarded by projectiles from multiple enemies at once with very few healing pickups on site. These instances pigeonhole players into using specific builds of Active and Passive ability cards, i.e. either heavy defense (e.g. Life Steal, Resistance, Iron Skin) or full offense (e.g. Might/Almighty, Dirty Tricks). Furthermore, since there are only 3 slots, they will never use the remaining 90% of cards. What’s worse, weapon types have a similar problem as around half of them are either too gimmicky or mediocre to be worth anyone’s time. A few appear to be good only to be kneecapped by absurdly long reload times forcing the player to abuse the passive reload mechanic (i.e., switching to a different weapon for some time during which the previous one reloads by itself in the background). In summation, despite customization options, most players will use cookie cutter min-max builds as the game punishes them for not doing so, which in turn makes it plainly boring in the long run. The flashlight being required in most levels while at the same time being a separate source of tedium due to needing to regularly wind it up doesn't help the situation either.

Forgive Me Father 2 was enjoyable for a single playthrough, but when I attempted to find all collectibles by replaying levels, I quickly found myself very disinterested and dropped it shortly after. Make of it what you will.
