I've been a huge pinball fan my entire life, to the point where I recently bought my own real machine. I've been playing Pinball Arcade since it first came out. I've spent an obscene amount on buying literally all the table DLC on PC and some of it on Android. I backed two of FarSight's Kickstarters to add loved but expensive tables to the collection (Star Trek: The Next Generation and Terminator 2: Judgement Day.)

So given all that, you may be asking, what's with the negative review?

Simply put, Pinball Arcade is a great place to play some of the best pinball tables ever made but due to licensing and overall poor and inconsistent design, the collection is a shadow of its former self and even when at its peak, I don't think the cost of entry was worth it for all but the most die hard fans who didn't mind spending way too much (i.e. me.)

Virtually all of FarSight Studios' catalog is what can be charitably described as "value titles", known to most gamers as shovelware. This is not a AAA or even AA studio, nor has it ever tried to be. After moderate success with previous pinball collections for 7th generation consoles, Pinball Arcade was a big shift in both direction and ambition, especially when you see the crazy number of platforms it's on (though thanks to their crooked publisher for the console versions, there are a lot of mismatches between them.) They wanted to bring as much of the world of pinball as possible to as many platforms as possible and they claimed, with as much authenticity as possible. I thought that was great. I didn't even mind that you had to buy the DLCs for each platform because that was less due to their greed and more due to the requirements of the license holders.

Whether or not you'll like the tables on offer is down to personal taste and that's not where my issues lie. My issues are with the myriad technical and design deficiencies that really damage the overall quality of the package and really make you question whether it's worth the asking price to buy what tables remain. Just some examples:

[list]
[*]All tables use the same physics model. It's not bad (certainly better than the ping pong ball model of Pinball FX) but it's not remotely close to the level of simulation they promise and some tables play not at all like their real life counterparts.
[*]PS2 era UI that's ugly, dated and clumsy to navigate.
[*]Huge inconsistency in table visual quality. Some tables look great, others are blurry messes not even close to the "astonishing detail" the Steam description promises.
[*]Same issues with table sounds. Some are good, others are much lower quality.
[*]Environment textures are ugly and low-res.
[*]Frame rate is inconsistent unless you're running hardware way more powerful than this should require.
[*]Online play (which is still listed in the menu as Beta) just says Coming Soon when you select it. It's been this way for years and presumably, will never be finished.
[*]Terrible account system that regularly doesn't work and requires you to reset your password multiple times before being able to sign in.
[*]Ugly, unintuitive leaderboard system.
[*]DirectX 11 mode that will push any GPU to its knees, while somehow looking worse.
[*]Table goals (which are tied to achievements) that occasionally don't unlock.
[*]Hasn't been updated in forever and no new tables have been announced. Most likely has been abandoned by FarSight.
[/list]

And of course, there's the fact that a huge number of Bally and Williams tables are no longer available for purchase, due to FarSight losing the license from WMS Industries. There's speculation as to whose fault that is but Williams is now in Pinball FX 3, where there are fewer tables that play worse than they do here. Don't get me wrong, there are still a lot of great tables available in Pinball Arcade but the Williams ones were definitely among the best and those are now long gone. The lack of support and new additions coincide pretty close with them losing the Williams license so needless to say, I think FarSight has decided to move on.

There is fun to be had here and if you're a pinball fanatic, you probably own this already. Despite my negative review, I continue to play this a lot and will keep doing so. But the reason I bought all this was because it was the only place to play most of these tables that I loved from my youth, not because I thought it was a good package and definitely not because I had or have confidence in FarSight Studios as a developer. Know what you're getting into before picking this up and definitely give the free table a try to see. I hope that one day, another studio can try the "pinball preservation" experiment that Pinball Arcade did, only with a more caring and skilled developer behind it.

——顺便安利一部非常契合情人节基调的视觉小说游戏，我是说，如果你同我一样没有更加刺激的活动的话，为什么不尝试一点浪漫又谐趣的故事呢（惨兮兮的眼神望着你）。

免费视觉小说中往往有一些非常与众不同的作品，他们或表现着与众不同的题材，或有着深刻的思辨，或者传达着作者本人的心声——比如科幻-犯罪题材的Lucid 9，比如我即将试试的Sepia Tears，比如这部One Thousand Lies。或许在不必顾虑各种功利因素的同时，这些作者也得以摒弃所有俗套的故事和空洞的福利内容（当然客观上也没有这样的条件），而放手写自己想写的东西。作者想得到的也不是盈利，而是大家的正向反馈吧有兴趣的同学可以看看itch上连篇累牍的玩后感，以及作者本人同样长篇大论的回复。

虽说是免费的，但这完全不是粗制滥造的作品，几十首配乐（包含一些不错的钢琴曲），意外养眼的立绘和背景（第一眼就喜欢上了Luce！）以及最重要的，又流畅又幽默的校园生活段落，深刻而内省式的心理描写，以及动人的人物刻画（Luce真是越看越爱啊！）都是明证。我本来只是下下来想稍微看眼这是个怎样的游戏就作罢——但是却鬼使神差的看了十几个小时，忍不住为之而怦然心动（哦，Luce，这个名字虽然像月亮，但其实是太阳！）。

这是一个欧洲小镇青年和他的伙伴们甜蜜中带着点苦涩的成长与情感故事——这么说起来一点感觉都没有，想看更有趣的说明的话不妨看看商店页面上的简介与角色自述（天哪我真希望每个galgame的人设介绍都能是这个风格的），一眼就能看出游戏的与众不同。语言障碍可能是个问题，尤其是开场几个段落的内容比较复杂，不过只要过了这点，就会变成通俗口语的（虽然可能还是夹杂了些心理学术语吧）。我不知道故事里面带有多少自传体色彩，不过记住作者是个安达卢西亚人，他以一己之力把自己的作品从西班牙语翻成了英文，不会很难的。

当然，如果只是为全成就而来的话，这也是个全程ctrl一刻钟就能拿走唯一一个成就的游戏···不过你会错过更重要的东西的，嗯。

最后，Only the truth and nothing else but the truth，如果你还在想是不是该玩下此游戏的话，就试试吧，不会后悔的。

After playing Metro 2033 and Metro: Last Light, I was ready to jump into Metro Exodus. A friend told me it was different, which worried me a bit, but once I started, it felt familiar… until I left Moscow. Suddenly, I wasn’t crawling through dark tunnels anymore but wandering the wide, ruined landscapes of post-apocalyptic Russia. It threw me off at first, but honestly, it’s a great change.

Each area feels unique and full of detail, and the game looks absolutely gorgeous. The graphics, world design, writing, and voice acting are all a huge step up from the earlier games. The gunplay still feels solid, and I really liked the crafting system and scavenging for parts and upgrading weapons.

The creepy, supernatural stuff from the first two games is mostly gone, but that didn’t bother me since I do not really like scary things. Exodus focuses more on survival and exploration, and that made me happy.

As for the DLCs, The Two Colonels is short but hits hard emotionally, while Sam’s Story is more action-heavy with another great ending.

Metro Exodus might be different, but to me, it’s the best of the series. It’s beautiful, emotional, and packed with atmosphere. It's a must-play for those that love story-driven shooters.

It's honestly hard to review this game because it's a struggle to find anything that I don't like about it. In short, Beastieball is kind of like: what if Pokemon was written like Undertale and scored by Lena Raine, had an immensely streamlined quality of life upgrade across the board, cared about game balance as a first principle, had interesting field positioning and captured everything compelling about its combat while removing all RNG from it? It sounds too good to be true because, by all means, it should be. But Beastieball achieves that with flying colors.

This is not really a game of particularly high stakes or scale. It's a creature collector about volleyball and a world centered around it, and while it honors many traditional game mechanics of its genre, it subverts many of them with the knowledge that you can pick yourself up after a loss and try again. Your beasties gain levels from losing to higher level opponents, even faster than they do from quickly defeating many weaker opponents. The game's conflict is not really about whether you win your games, it's about striving to get better and learning from each one. Nothing sells this more than the fact that the game's combat is balanced to a level of airtightness that feels beyond compare. It feels like the developers began with an outline for a healthy PvP game and the single-player experience branches out in a way that teaches the player how to improve, causing all the systems to feel not only logical, but equally compelling. Not wanting to be overleveled, I capped my level to the average of each Ranked coach I faced from city to city and the game gave me a level of immersive difficulty that I don't think I've ever felt before. Your opponents are smart, experienced, and they want to win.

But the thing I appreciate the most about this game, even more than its simultaneously endearing and gorgeous presentation and masterfully designed combat mechanics, is its sincerity. The world of Beastieball is a fundamentally silly one, where the concept of volleyball exists in nature and a wide variety of lifeforms intuitively go out of their way to play it. The writers have a good sense of humor about this. But at the same time, the NPCs have so many different compelling and relatable perspectives and wants, bringing a kind of personal seriousness that constantly glimmers through the game's otherwise cartoony tone. I watched as two of my Beasties experienced an entire story arc of rivalry and mutual appreciation told entirely through mechanical interactions. Several of the characters that I assumed were just hanging around to explain parts of the world went through changes that I didn't at all expect.

In short, what I appreciate most about Beastieball is that in addition to doing everything well, it openly wears its heart on its sleeve. And that makes it plain to see how warm and full it is.

После долгих размышлений о том, стоит ли писать обзор на Greedfall, я решил, что игра всё же заслуживает внимания.
Сюжет игры интересен и во многом напоминает мне игру которую совсем недавно проходил A Plague Tale, так как в Greedfall основная линия вращается вокруг поиска лекарства от чумы, которая здесь именуется Мелихорой.
Главный герой, Де Сарде он Эмиссар содружества, и по большей части он пытается решить проблемы между враждующими сторонами, я старался отыгрывать его в доброй роли и выбрал путь дипломатии. Однако игра предоставляет возможность, как я понял выбрать и темный путь, в зависимости от ваших реплик, что добавляет вариативности и интереса.(а также влияние на концовки)
В процессе игры Де Сарде знакомится с несколькими спутниками которые на протяжении всей игры будут помогать главному герою иногда не только в сражениях, а например разрешить сложную политическую задачу. Спутников их не так много, но каждый из них запоминается за свою особую харизму. Плюс к этому, разработчики сделали систему диалогов весьма увлекательной например во время разговора может вмешаться ваш напарник и высказать свою точку зрения, что иногда может повлиять на уровень дружбы с главным героем, или же с другими спутниками, поэтому советую вам  стоит тут быть особенно осмотрительным в плане выбора. (также можно упустить возможность развить романтическую линию)
Для каждого спутника предусмотрены дополнительные миссии, которые я прошел все, и могу сказать, что они достаточно увлекательные, хотя есть конечно и такие которые немало утомляют, поэтому тут уж как говорится насколько у вас развито терпение, бегать придётся немало, а квестов по типу подай принеси хоть отбавляй) Также существует возможность романтических отношений с вашим спутником, хотя я не уделял этому должного внимания, Сиора мне показалась достаточно привлекательной.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3596621991
Что касается дополнительных миссий, если проходить их все, игра может затянуться на 10-20 часов, в зависимости от вашего стиля игры. Я заметил, что много квестов стоят внимания, но есть и скучные, которые могут заставить вас пропустить их и продолжить основную сюжетную линию.
Мир игры нельзя назвать большим, но в нем есть достаточно пространства для исследований. Он полуоткрытый, и частые загрузки при переходе между локациями могут немного раздражать. Однако, учитывая, что игру разработала небольшая команда, это не столь критично, и стоит дать проекту шанс проявить себя. В начале конечно же может быть скучно, но через 5-10 часов игра раскроет свой потенциал.
Геймплей мне напомнил Ведьмака 2 с похожей боевой системой. Лично мне это нравится система комбо доставляет удовольствие при уничтожении врагов. В игре есть возможность прокачки персонажа, и на начальных этапах доступна только механика уклонений или отскока проще говоря, но если немного прокачать персонажа откроется ещё и перекат. Интересной особенностью является то, что некоторые места для их открытия требуют определенных параметров, таких как энергичность или интуиция, это немного напомнило мне механику метроидвании.
Также мне понравилась кастомизация брони и оружия, визуальная часть выглядит красиво и приятно, а прокачка персонажа приносит удовольствие. Мне показалась в начале система прокачки сложноватой, но на самом деле она довольно проста-стоит лишь потратить время на изучение правильных и полезных навыков. Бои представляют собой смесь ударов мечом или чем то более увесистым, а также уклонений пинков ногой, и парирования, что добавляет динамики. Противники достаточно живучие, и даже на среднем уровне сложности были моменты, когда приходилось немного попотеть, что меня кстати порадовало. Особых ожиданий у меня не было на эту игру поэтому и выбрал по быстренькому пройти на средней сложности, но по итогу в игре задержался на 65 часов)
Немного о минусах: к сожалению, разнообразия противников не так много, но разработчики стремились создать уникальный мир, где гармонично сосуществуют магия, оружие и ближний бой, и мне кажется у них это неплохо получилось, и они привнесли что то новое своим творением.
Немного о графике: несмотря на небольшой состав команды разработчиков, графика игры выглядит симпатично. Бывают моменты, когда хочется остановиться и насладиться окружающими пейзажами. Анимация сражений также на достойном уровне.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3601346254
Что касается музыки она не произвела на меня сильного впечатления, но и не разочаровала. В целом есть несколько приятных мелодий, но не более.
В заключение, могу сказать, что Greedfall - это неплохой, средний проект, который определенно стоит пройти хотя бы раз, но не более того.

This game man - this is so close to perfection.
I've had it sat in my library for a long while assuming it to be another top down roguelike like so many others, but nah this is special. 

It's a roguelike which feels like escape from tarkov meets space station 13 meets doom. You are essentially a mercenary taking jobs from the various factions in some form of anarchocapitalistic future where everyone is sabotaging each other to take over planets. You fly your mercenary ship filled with clones to go and take on these missions on planets - often with objectives like destroying something or killing x number of inhabitants. Each planet you land on has several floors and your goal then is to find where your objective is whilst picking up valuables to take back to upgrade aspects like your ship/weapons/armour and to better outfit your clone for next time.
It is this aspect of scavenging with the difficulty involved (like Tarkov and similar extraction shooters) which makes the game very addictive - every mission is a gamble of whether to go in well equipped to take on threats or go in light to hope you can bring back more stuff for future missions. As you complete missions and travel time passes in the universe and as time passes the factions get stronger, with a ranking system meaning that if you neglect some factions they may get weaker and may be destroyed altogether. As factions get stronger they get better weapons/armour when encountered in missions - and if you complete missions for specific factions you can then also trade with them to get these items for yourself. 

The gameplay is played in a turn based fashion making it *chefs kiss* perfect for second monitor play, it can be brutally difficult but also largely forgiving. It can pretty much be solely played with a mouse as you navigate by clicking and can attack and loot in the same way. Weapons you find vary in damage types and enemies you fight can be targeted in a variety of ways, with a body damage system and aspects such as poisoning and sickness present with a range of cures for specific injuries - again with clear inspiration from Tarkov.
A unique twist is that for many planets/missions there is a 'Quasimorphisis' scale which grows as more people die on the map, at a certain point demons then begin spawning in and taking over the bodies of those you kill recently - with these demons getting progressively more dangerous the bigger the quasimorphosis scale grows, adding to a time/threat pressure for missions. Like many things in this game this too can also be managed with certain foods/items reducing the quasimorphosis scaling.

The art and sound is also fantastic, there are tonnes of items and weapons in this game and plenty to see - with 140hrs playtime so far I feel I probably still have about 30% of the items yet to be seen given the scaling and longterm play design.

Weaknesses for the game include missions sometimes feeling samey / not worth the risk (escort missions especially), enemies sometimes acting quite 'dumb' (some missions are best solved standing in one place with a shotgun) and the sort of monopoly feeling outcome where if you are losing in the later stages of the game it can become a spiral of repeated failing  without managing to get many items in return.

That said, this game is still fantastic and the developer is constantly adding new features whilst in early access - a 9/10 for me and amongst my favourite games I've played this year

This game was fun in the beginning when the amount of people playing it overshadowed it's glaring failures, but now that the game is empty the gigantic holes are the dominant feature of the game.
All the enjoyable people are gone, and the only ones who remain are the hyper obsessive, socially inept neanderthals with little to no social skills and excessive amounts of free time.  People who chose to completely detach from human to human interaction and instead replace their entire life with a digital world that offers mediocre gameplay and an opportunity to grind forever with the hopes of gaining an economic advantage over imaginary opponents they hope will some day materialize into existence to justify their life choices.

The combat is OK.  It's neat having to manually aim your attacks and your spells, but its heavily ping dependent.  They say they employ some sort of ping equalisation technology, but it can only really do so much.   If you have a really low ping, which you'll need to live in England to have, you'll have an advantage over everyone who doesn't except for people who live on the other side of the world, where their extreme ping will cause the low ping timing issues.  But if you live anywhere in the middle of England and New Zealand, you'll be at a disadvantage against those who live in those areas.
If you want to have full access to the different playstyles of the game or be self-sufficient, which you will want to, you are required to have multiple accounts.  So instead of paying for 1 account, you'll have to have 2-4.  So not just $15 a month, but 30-60 dollars a month to fully play and enjoy the game.
The development team is very small, practically non-existent.  This game has gone multiple 6+ month stretches with zero updates/patches, and has bugs that have existed since the game's release, with new bugs being introduced with every patch (that rarely come due to small dev team), and old bugs being continuously neglected.

This game was fun in the beginning, and you can still get some enjoyment if you're trying it for the first time and want to see something different and want to have a bunch of different game mechanics to learn, but eventually you'll realize the purpose of doing those things doesn't exist anymore, because there aren't enough people and the ones who are left are the ones not worth associating with.

If you want to try it out and see what could have been, give it a go.  But if you're looking for something new to lose yourself in, this isn't it.

I'm sure we've all known Jeckas, who are popular and only seem to want to hurt others who they percieve as less than them. This game is amazing! Let me give you a review from someone that's comfort level 5, 16,800 plots of farmland, and maxed out their mech and animal pens.

I see a lot of reviews from players who haven't even touched the game for an hour and think they know everything about the game. Talk about ignorance. 

Here's the bread and butter: 
1. SO COZY- Between the soft lofi beats, the calm sounds of the water, the wind, and the machinery working, the atmosphere is beyond relaxing. 
2. You like mechs?! IT HAS MECHS! Seriously, the amount of customization and transformation you can do to this mech while every change runs seemlessly is amazing. 
3. BRING FRIENDS! One of the best games to create a farm with while exploring everything. Don't get me started on how funny it is to watch them get sucked into tornadoes and sent across the map!
4. NPC's - Their is plenty of wildlife roaming around, animals to raise, and 2 very friendly and funny npc characters to chat with and complete some quests for them. 
5. DRONES! I love these little buggers. I have 16,800 plots (and I can make more) and with 11 drone stations I'm able to fully water and maintain all of my plots without any struggles. 
6. Building/Crafting - It's gorgeous. It's not perfect, but it's fantastic once you get the hang of it. All I ask for are more items to decorate with. Especially lighting options. I want more! I also appreciate the fact you have to have proper support in order to hold up roofs, ceilings, and beams.
7. The SCENERY! The views, the clouds, the sky, the colors, and the planets. Chefs kiss! Everything is so beautiful! 

As a game in early development still, this is an A+ game. Ignore the haters who clearly haven't spent any time in the game.

Después de unos días de reflexionar, creo que puedo hacer esta reseña como corresponde.
Dead Space 2 es prácticamente todo lo que una secuela debería ser: es una evolución. El gameplay evoluciona, la historia evoluciona, el diseño de nivel evoluciona, todo avanza de forma orgánica y maravillosa. La narrativa de Isaac, ahora con voz, lidiando con las secuelas de la Efigie y de las verdades del primer juego son magistrales. Los constantes intercambios con Nicole son pesados de ver, y aportan a la sensación constante de que manejamos a un hombre roto que usa todas sus fuerzas para mantener la poca compostura que le queda. Nicole es excelente como símbolo del peso que Isaac lleva encima, representando y reveleando múltiples facetas del mismo a lo largo de la narrativa. 
El gameplay ha progresado, se siente familiar pero mas fluido, y las herramientas disponibles son mucho más responsivas. El juego te incentiva a variar y experimentar con las opciones que uno lleva, opuesto a DS1, donde la Cortadora servía para prácticamente todas las situaciones. La progresión sin embargo deja un poco que desear, especialmente por el nuevo sistema de armaduras, el cual ya no se siente como Isaac poco a poco completando su traje, cosa que extraño del primer juego. 游戏画面相较原版得到了很大的，关卡多且复杂，出于游戏引擎限制依旧是只能把单个大章节拆分成多个小关卡串联起来，没能把单个章节合并成一个无缝大关卡确实有些遗憾，不知道未来的Black Mesa重制版会不会把每个章节合并成无缝连接的地图。
游戏里在地球上的关卡还比较好辨识找路，但是传送到Xen星上后，尤其是到了弗地冈村落那边后，不仅环境光暗的可怜，路也藏得很深……即便是游戏内亮度调到了最高都感觉难以辨识……(;´Д｀)
整个游戏流程除了体验关于戈登弗里曼的剧情外，其余主要就是与敌人交火（前期丧尸和政府军士兵，后期外星人），3D平台跳跃，找路及解密了。最让咱印象深刻的就是搬运帽子披萨和毒气罐……;つД｀)帽子在战斗中被爆炸轰飞后与阴影融为一体不知所踪……( ;∀;)披萨则是在上梯子的时候非常容易被栅栏卡掉……好在毒气罐不需要运多远……
黑山基地十项全能中与多只独眼巨人的追逐逃亡战，以及躲红外线激光的碟中谍关卡也让咱非常的印象深刻……都是在其它FPS游戏中未曾体验过的……
全成就通关后对各个关卡的丰富程度及复杂构造都感到叹为观止……是个值得推荐好好品味的优秀FPS游戏。('ω')ノ
P.S.游戏成就中的【PhD in Pacifism】，咱专门留心刻意不误伤弗地冈人过的关，但没有获得成就，之后重试了多次依旧无法解锁，查询Steam社区指南和评论区后发现，该成就在游戏内的触发器有BUG，需要搜索X:\Steam\steamapps\common\Black Mesa路径下的gamestate.txt文件，找到其中的"id" "28"这一项，将下方的"data" 后的数值改成"0x0000000001111110"后保存，再重回游戏达成成就条件方可获得。

总之对个人来说从看见预告片里方头战舰的那一刻我的手就不听使唤了……
玩了十几小时后给可能有在观望的小伙伴简单介绍下游戏内容吧——
首先是2项前排劝退:
1.操作手感，这是个动作游戏，如果你是那种对动作游戏手感要求必须时刻丝般润滑，能够360旋转跳跃甩技能的玩家又或者没啥太大耐心的暴躁老哥，那就可以直接不用看了，游戏中船的惯性非常大，再配上洋流的存在，很多时候(比如逆水/峡湾转身/紧急性的加减速)手感时不时就会变的笨拙糟糕到足以让你摔键盘的地步(具体来说堪比欧卡2倒车)，但如果你要能耐心地适应个把小时后，游戏的整个操作手感总体来说是非常有节奏感且有代入感的；
2.服务器，游戏目前玩家非常少，少到玩个3-5局都能经常见到几张老面孔的地步，亚服甚至欧服都根本匹配不满人，能玩的只有美服，虽然神奇的是我没用任何加速器直连美服玩起来也从来不卡；
--------------------
如果以上2点且没中文都没阻止你的话，可以接着看下算是新手科普向的几项游戏核心机制：
1.船体护甲，所有战舰的总体血量分护甲+船体两者，而护甲又分为前后左右4处独立计算，其中任何一处被击破后敌方便能轰击你的船体对本体血量造成伤害，血量为0即爆船，所以在游戏中你必须时刻关注自己和敌方的各方位护甲，永远避免暴露自己并轰击敌方最薄弱的一面，再配上前面所说的"笨拙"的操作手感当你在逆境中拼力调动舰船方位防御并反击对手时代入感反而是爆棚的，毕竟你不能指望一艘风帆/蒸汽战船像翻积木似的左侧受损了一秒就切换到右侧………当你脱离战斗后会有自动的缓慢护甲修复以及游戏中按alt隐藏/显示自己船体护甲；
2.火力，游戏一共3种炮弹，分别为1号键直接对敌方护甲/船体造成伤害的轰击大炮，2号键打击敌方风帆战舰船帆以造成减速的链炮(矮人都是蒸汽船所以链炮对他们无效)和3号键对船员造成伤害的散射火炮，具体使用因人因环境而异。此外不同船长还会有些特殊攻击技能(比如矮人鱼雷)，以及最最最精彩的部分——头槌，真正的船长甭管对面是一艘战舰或者一面山崖又甚至一头海怪，就一个字:撞!撞特么的，今天不撞破自己脑袋算我输!尤其是那些兽人战舰，正面高甲+额外冲撞伤害，就是为撞而生！好吧，讲正经的，通常当你采取头槌策略时，切记撞尾撞身不撞脸，尤其当对手还是一艘矮人破浪者(小船)时，我已经记不清有多少热血的年轻绿皮船长仗着自以为头硬在朝我发起死亡冲击时却被照面鱼雷接短距(高伤!)火炮一发入魂后，翻船的反而是他自己…………
3.buff，一共5种，攻击，防御，移速，暴击和护甲修理包，简单粗暴，也是至关重要的一环，游戏会定期刷新一定数量的AI海盗船掉落金币和buff，除修理包外获取后可一直叠加持续到整场比赛结束或爆船后掉落，在每局比赛中后期双方身上累积的buff层数如果差距过大，那战果完全是碾压性的，所以除非自己有100%把握快速解决掉对手，否则前期多打野别恋战，尤其新手还缺大量金币去升级舰船，所以多打野没坏处；
4.装备，装备分为战舰本身的5项船体升级和宝箱中开出的船长还有战斗结束有几率获取的船员，都是些对战舰各方面数据上的提升，其中船员属性随机且有5星品质!(为何这个世界总是要对非酋充满如此多的恶意，酸爽，SHUWAAAGH起来!)好在除船长主动技能和10级战舰的最终升级外(船长现在开始游戏直接赠送一个，后续还可在升级箱子中开出，总之获取很简单，而10级战舰略微遥远慢慢肝就行了)，装备对整体实力的影响并不是太大，新手期如果碰到有被秒体验，别怀疑那通常就是你被人buff碾压了而不是装备，又或者像前面说的铁头绿皮船长们——完全性的战略错误；
5.船员,这里说的船员不是那个装备，而是游戏中左侧有个红色的船员血量条，可以通过接舷战(鼠标右键)和3号炮弹消耗对手船员，当船员遭受损耗时你的炮弹装填速度和脱战后的护甲修复速度都会相应减慢，当然脱战后船员也会缓慢回复伤势，此外如果对方消灭了你的船员，那在他下次再次接舷登录你时就可以直接砸爆你的舰(gou)船(tou)………
---------------------
以上，基本就是新手需要注意的一些核心机制，且游戏中你点开wiki会有更详细的各种介绍，这也算是游戏目前最大的一个缺点吧，他把这些内容全一股脑儿地扔进左下角那小小的wiki按钮里，新手上来首先看到的却是界面上一堆各种UI图标而又不能鼠标移动上去看看那都是些什么鬼，真是一头雾水+逼死强迫症，至于怎么开船还有地形之类，都是需要自己去浪个几把才有所体会的。
--------------------
最后游戏模式目前就只有加入了强调打野概念的吃鸡那一套，15艘船轰到剩最后1艘（组队战不清楚,没玩过），海怪(毒)圈定时缩小战场地图，另外由于海怪扑人貌似完全随机，所以有时打到最后完全黑水双方都僵持不下时，通常由海怪大爷当时心情决定谁是最后赢家……
如果真碰到这种局，果断接舷战拖住对方，海怪一撞撞俩，真船长宁为玉碎不为瓦全!!虽然我也不知道这种最后结算结果会是怎样，第一次也是唯一一次碰到那种局面时我当了海怪大爷选择的那个幸运儿……
[spoiler] 打完我就掉线了，大快人心！	[/spoiler]
同样的游戏也没任何死亡惩罚，事实上连死亡都没，因为爆船之后立马会一溜烟"战术撤退"出一艘救生小艇让你还可以在一旁观战(说好的发誓船亡人在呢?!狡诈无耻的矮人海盗!)，偶尔遇见一些最终决战，比如大漩涡上的追逐战还是颇具观赏性的。
---------------------
总体来说支撑起游戏的更多还是他优良的舰船设计(就目前9种舰船来说平衡性做的还是相当不错的)和出色的水体效果带来的代入感，所以如果再出一些其他模式，比如抢地盘的阵营战甚至打海怪的合作战目测都是完全可行的，还在ea阶段，看制作组如何继续拓展了；
如果你是奇幻+海战题材类游戏的爱好者，无脑入就行了，颇具节奏的战斗体验和令人沉浸的代入感是绝不会让你失望的。
---------------------
写了这么多，然并卵，没有中文最为致命，希望能有中文吧，虽然舰船操作就是浪浪浪轰轰轰就行了，但毕竟游戏还是有不少关于装备/船员属性的描述文字是需要去获悉一下的；
总之………撞起来!

Exceptional game that deserves more attention than it receives. Making a caravan-style trading game interesting relies heavily on a living. In this Vagrus exceeds expectations. Review: An Arcade Full of Cats

An Arcade Full of Cats is a charming and relaxing hidden object game that combines nostalgia, light humor, and—of course—adorable cats. As a fan of casual games, I found this title to be a delightful way to spend a few hours.

What I liked:

Art Style and Theme: The pixel art is colorful and full of retro arcade charm. Each level is inspired by classic video games and pop culture, which adds a fun layer of discovery beyond just finding cats.

Cats, Cats, Cats: True to its name, the game is full of cats in all sorts of quirky costumes and poses. It’s perfect for cat lovers or anyone looking for a wholesome, low-stress game.

Relaxing Gameplay: There's no timer or pressure, so it’s ideal for unwinding. The background music is pleasant and fits the laid-back atmosphere.

What I disliked:

Repetitive Elements: While fun, the gameplay loop can become repetitive over time. If you're not into hidden object games or pixel-hunting, it might lose its charm after a while.

Sometimes a Bit Too Hidden: A few cats can be very well-hidden, occasionally leading to frustration. A hint system is available, but it could be a little more refined.

Would I recommend it?

Absolutely—especially for fans of cats, hidden object games, or retro arcade aesthetics. It's lighthearted, stress-free, and made with clear love for the genre and subject matter. Whether you're looking to kill some time or just want a smile on your face, An Arcade Full of Cats is worth checking out.

[h3]A Forgotten Ride[/h3]

Back in 2019 I bought this game because I really liked the Mad Max film and thought that this would be a hell of a ride. And it indeed was, I was so immersed in the world and everything around it. But then I suddenly dropped the game and never came back to it - probably because of my false hopes of becoming pro in Counter Strike or Rocket League. But now 6 years later I remembered that it lays buried in my library, waiting to be finished. Not the pick I intended, but it had to be done. Because nowadays in the modern era of gaming it is really difficult to finish old forgotten games and not get pulled to the newest releases, especially when you hear everybody yapping about how great each new game is. It has been really hard to choose this over finally buying Clair Obscure. But I’m glad I resisted and stayed with Mad Max till the end.

It’s not because I want to be blind and avoid Clair Obscure, but because I was able avoid my impulsive tendencies to buy myself a new game after paycheck. I will eventually play it but I have so many untouched games in my backlog that haunt me whenever I play something freshly bought.

But playing Mad Max was like a ride on a roller coaster. One time I was really enjoying it and was able to play it all day and then leave it untouched for 4 days straight. 

[u]Story[/u]
(Be wary, there will be spoilers, so feel free to skip it.)

I believe that Mad Max has always been about the action and not much about the story. But still, I can’t look past it because here it has potential to be at least decent, but it’s so undercooked. It starts as a basic revenge story that has some potential to be spiced with something but fails. There first half of the game is good, the main enemy feels like a really powerful leader and a great threat but once a player gets to the Gastown everything starts to be extremely rushed. My biggest problem is especially with the Avalanche studio trying to implement a romantic relationship in the game with no structure whatsoever. There is this woman that asks you to find her child and once you do that she suddenly wants to start a family with you. There is no buildup, barely any dialog between Max and her and now she’s all over him with her child. If you want me to care about her give me at least some time to get to know her. And you know what’s worse? In the final fight Max is not in it for a revenge just because he got his car stolen, but rather for what was done to her. And while doing that he totally ignores his pall who was helping him from the beginning and kills him. Oh I was so mad. It would have worked if they gave him time to get to know her. But no, they just butchered it in the last 4 hours of the game.

Thankfully that’s the only thing this game did terribly.

[u]Gameplay[/u]
The gameplay feels nice to play. Its main pulling point for players is probably the combat in cars and that is very well done. What surprised me about it was that I had to be really careful how I chose to destroy each enemy car. I thought that I was going to just mindlessly crash into everyone and that would be it, but the car is pretty fragile and that helps to keep the player more focused. You can upgrade it to the point that it is almost unbeatable, but that takes so much time of grinding scrap all over the map. Which gets really boring, because sometimes you just find 15 scrap in one place and you need 1500 for next upgrade in the late game.

Ground combat is on the other hand really simple, all you have to do is mindlessly mash attack button and occasionally press parry. Some attacks can’t be parried, so you have to dash and that’s pretty much it. There is a way to unlock more moves, but majority of upgrades just increase damage or defense. It’s a very single beat em up style of combat with some cool looking animations that make it at least somewhat entertaining.

The game lacks a good variety of enemies especially on the ground. There is standard enemy which is easy to kill, guys that dodge a lot, small guys, armored guys and top dogs. That’s pretty much it. With this little variety I can’t see myself doing every objective and clearing every enemy camp in the game. I tried that in some days, but it got extremely boring. I don’t understand why there is in every region a Top Dog camp, where is always the same boss just with different face paint and slightly different arena layout. There are only few of those guys, why not make everyone stand out? Is that so hard?!

The only unique enemy was the main boss himself and that wasn’t even a hard or fun fight. Basically the same strategy that I applied for the Top Dogs, dodge his incredibly obvious attack and then punish him. There was not so much variety of attacks and the main boss fight was very easy and forgettable.

[u]The World[/u]
What kept me interested in the game were the vibes this gives off. There is something about hunting the V8 and hearing the cars go vroom in the middle of nowhere in a dead world. I am not a fan of post apocalyptic worlds, but this one charmed me. I like how disgusting it is, everyone has gone crazy and there is zero hope for better days.

I enjoyed reading every history relic I found while traveling even though they didn’t really add much to the story. But it was nice to see how much the world has changed.

I know that there are plenty of better post apocalyptic worlds that make better sense, but this one is somehow close to my heart. It might be thanks to me seeing the Mad Max: Fury Road as a teenager and really loving it.

I also like the whole look of the game, its age is visible, but it still manages to look really good. It might be thanks to the world being so simple, after all there is just a huge desert with some variety here and there.

[u]Final Thoughts[/u]
Overall I somehow still enjoyed the game even though I was disappointed with the story and enemy variety. It was a nostalgic experience where everything reminded me of the days I was just going to school and had no responsibilities. I’m happy that I remembered that I have this game and played it, but I don’t think that I will play this in a while.

It’s a game made for the fans of the movie that came in 2015 with non gamers in mind. But still I don’t know if I would recommend it to my friends, there are so many better games out there and this one is only for those who are particularly interested in a Mad Max game.

3/5

I first played Granado Espada years ago and stepped away in 2019, frustrated that I couldn’t immediately compete in PvP. I focused on other games, but honestly…I missed it. So here I am in 2025, back in the game and loving it.

Yes, the cash shop is still part of the game. Rare characters often debut there first, and if you want the latest top-tier lineup on day one, you’ll pay for it. But that’s true of most long-running MMORPGs. The key difference now is that catch-up mechanics and luck-based events make rare characters and strong mid-game gear genuinely attainable just by playing. You can grind, quest, and gradually build a solid roster without spending a dime.

What makes GE stand out is the lifestyle fit: you can legally auto-grind. I leave my squad farming while I work, do chores, or run errands, then come back to see real progress. For a busy adult who still loves MMORPGs, that’s gold.

The community feels healthier too. Botting is way down, and the “I was banned for no reason!” posts you see are usually from mule accounts that got caught.

A few quick ratings:

Gameplay – 10/10: The unique 3-character MCC system still feels fresh and strategic.

BGM – 10/10: One of the best soundtracks in any MMO, period.

Cash Shop – 7/10: Optional but present; control your spending and it won’t control you.

Granado Espada remains a beautiful, distinctive MMORPG that keeps receiving updates. Don’t let old reviews scare you off and experience it yourself to decide. See you in the game, pioneers!

I tried to like this. 
It looks very charming, the premise is interesting, and being a soulslike seems like it would be right up my alley.

But although the beginning was pretty good. It starts showing its edges pretty quickly.
The combat feels very stiff and unresponsive. The timing for rolling and blocking/parrying feels incredibly off and combined with some of the later enemies and bosses tendencies to have very fast attacks this makes it feel less like you are learning the patterns of the enemies and more like you are just hoping that when you press the button and the game actually decides to do what you want just happens to line up.

The camera also being jank to say the least, I've had the lock on spazz out multiple times to the point where I just stopped using it because it would randomly decide to lock on to an enemy BEHIND ME, BEHIND A WALL instead of the one RIGHT IN FRONT OF ME. Or when enemies are above you below you it can get very difficult to see whats happening.

But the worst thing... oh lord the worst thing has got to be the platforming.
It constantly feels like you are platforming on an ice level in super mario. Everything is very slide-y, 
There are multiple areas you climb I'm not sure if I'm even doing the right thing or if I'm unintentionally trying to do some jank-geometry skip because the terrain "on-ground" detection is so bad at times.
I'll be walking on some "tightrope" style platforms in a section and my character will just suddenly slide off to the right and at best I'll "die" and respawn a few meters earlier or at worst I fall down a long section and have to redo the entire jank platforming again. While climbing on ropes the game might just randomly decide that just are not in fact holding on anymore, and randomly push you sideways off the wall, just far enough that you can not grab it again of course, so you fall down to your doom.

This game is difficult for all the wrong reasons. The parts I can tell are supposed to be difficult are easy, and the things that are difficult are difficult mostly just because they are frustrating, and it doesn't feel earned when you beat them, it just feels like you got lucky with the jank.

The audio also has issues. Very inconsistent volume for sounds and voice acting. I've had some characters I can barely hear and a few (most notably the chopstick boss and the first guard-captain) be so overbearingly loud compared to everything else I had to pause the boss fight to turn down the voice volume to do the fight.

The good parts of this game are the charm, humor, pop-culture references and a lot of the world building is fun and I was interesting in seeing how the story would go. I the gameplay was tight and polished this would be a very fun experience, and it might be worth it for you if you can stand the jank. It was not it for me.

[H1]Le point'n click le plus dynamique et nerveux que j'ai jamais vu[/H1]

Le point fort de The Drifter est incontestablement sa captivante narration. On ne s'ennuie jamais, avec cette mise en scène quasi cinématographique digne d'un film d'action. Carter est traqué et devra s'enfuir, se débarrasser de ses ennemis, enquêter et trouver des indices et échapper maintes et maintes fois à la mort. Et pourtant, il s'agit d'un point'n click on ne peut plus traditionnel : point de phases d'actions ici, vous devrez récolter des objets, les utiliser entre eux ou sur le décor, interroger les protagonistes pour progresser encore et encore. Mais, à l'instar des vieux Sierra, vous pourrez mourir. Qu'à cela ne tienne, pour une raison qui sera parfaitement expliquée dans le scénario, Carter remontera le temps quelques instants avant le moment fatal. Traumatisé du souvenir de sa mort, il aura une nouvelle chance pour s'en sortir.

Certains joueurs n'apprécieront d'ailleurs pas certaines phases qui se déroulent en temps limité. Un ennemi qui surgit, et à vous de trouver la bonne combinaison d'actions pour lui échapper avant qu'il ne vous élimine. Cependant, rassurez-vous : le jeu est loin d'être difficile et toutes les énigmes sont totalement logiques. De plus, Carter vous donnera quelques indices si vous séchez. La mort n'est ici pas punitive : elle permet d'apprendre pour mieux recommencer. Tant pour le joueur, qui gagnera cette expérience concrète, que pour Carter qui découvrira parfois des indices en perdant la vie. Cette mécanique est notamment très bien utilisée dans le tout dernier chapitre du jeu.

现在已经用了160个小时了，才刚刚做出游戏的序章和第一章...... 会不会是因为我的野心有点太大了啊？但不管怎么说，这个软件实现了我的儿时梦想，十分感激。我今后也要继续使用RM，书写属于我的勇者的传说。

BRAVO！

好吧，说点正经的。讲真，RM这个引擎现在确实是夕日红了，基本上以游戏性和画面来看，是有点落伍的，哪怕是最新版的MZ，也依然是基于MV的框架，这意味着它其实没什么创新。你不能指望你可以用这玩意手搓出类似《最终幻想》、《Tales Of》，或是《空之轨迹》、《伊苏》、《女神异闻录》一类的JRPG大作[spoiler]当然，你如果有那个精力和能力，一个人开发个几十年说不定可以（）[/spoiler]但RM也同样孵化了很多神作，特别是同人游戏。比如大家都很熟悉的《神之天平》、《废都物语》、《King Exit》、《野比大雄的生化危机》等，从剧情向神作再到许多喜闻乐见的小游戏，可以说，从我的初中到高中再到大学，RM一直都在。

开发游戏是要面临很多现实的难点的：首当其冲就是开发资源。我个人经过了一些摸索后，总结为三个方面：一是美术资源；二是声效资源；三是技术资源。第一点很好理解，除开复古向的CRPG一类的游戏，基本上现代的回合制也好、ACT也好、SLG也好，所有类型的游戏都要有角色的形象、立绘、地图、动画、场景之类的承载故事的媒介。第二点也很好理解，游戏也需要各类Sound Effect、BGM和BGS乃至角色的配音，插入曲等等。再然后是第三点，也是最困扰许多独立制作者的最大难点——技术资源。意味着你如何将前两者结合起来，实现各种游戏性上的构想。

RM几乎完全解决了这三大开发资源问题。默认的素材库就有许多优质的音效和BGM。说实话我自己就是做音乐的，但内置的很多BGM素材完成度已经很高（虽然我还是自己制作了不少BGM），只要用对场景，可以实现很多情绪的铺垫。还有精美的地图图块和角色立绘等。不仅如此，这个开发工具还以其易操作性而广为人知，整个软件的可视化做得十分优秀。学习时间大概在10~15小时，搞清楚底层逻辑即可掌握大部分功能。而再进一步，学会使用各类JS插件，甚至自己编写JS，也更能事半功倍。你可以用它做出市面上主流的各种类型的游戏[spoiler]当然最容易实现的还是传统的回合制RPG[/spoiler] 而且，正如RPG Maker之名，RM专为制作RPG而生，你可以用这个软件实现许多复杂的分支设计。为一个NPC设计出许许多多不同的对话和反应，设计不同的剧情和任务支线等等。我几乎敢断言，只要你想要做，通过RM最基础的变量和开关设计，你甚至可以实现贝塞斯达式的角色扮演体验。

不过综合来看，RM的定位或许更多还是介于开发者和玩家的中间点。你可以用RM追逐商业化的梦，也可以只是随便玩玩。软件本身的质量是非常优秀的，值得入手赏玩。只不过，也需要认清楚自己内心深处真正的渴望，[b]毕竟没有人希望自己投入大量时间和精力后几乎没有获得任何反馈。[/b]

不管怎么说，哈罗德的冒险仍然还在继续（笑）

2.加强怪物巢的概念，一个平房和一幢大楼的僵尸数量不可能一致。当我们解决了一些重点地区的巢穴后，将获得巨大的奖励。

4.增加载具种类和用途，加入载具改造系统。让不同载具的用途区别更大。

5.加入一些RPG要素和成就系统，比方说玩家可以花费大量资源给与小队成员颁发一定种类的勋章，少量的增加他们的基础属性，（前提是这位成员达到了勋章要求），这样可以解决后期大量资源囤积的问题，也能给与玩家一定代入感。

6.强化自动生成幸存者营地的功能，这些幸存者营地可以是零散的，也可以是强大的，有自己的发展方向的，可以中立、友好甚至敌对，会根据形势与玩家进行互动，贸易或者战斗，在完成他们的任务或者消灭他们以后，你可以接受他们的人员或者是掠夺他们的领地。
7.加入“超级工程”，在营地里可以制造一些末日幸存者所能建造到的最大的一些工程，比方说巨型瞭望塔，混凝土地堡一类的，每一个超级工程都有自己明确的用途，有些甚至会招来敌人。建造时间长，耗费巨大，占地巨大，但效果明显。

8.更多的与世界互动的任务。比方说寻找研究所，得到失传已久的科技配方一类的。防御堕落的军队对营地进攻.etc

9.一个有趣的广播电台。我们可以用AI实时生成一些与当前局势相关的简短广播。

[h1]Tantas horas em jogo e você não recomenda?[/h1]
Vamos separar alguns tópicos decisivos e entender o porque.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
Satisfatório, maravilhoso, parece até que Grand Chase evoluiu para esse jogo, sério é muito bom. Durante o progresso do jogo você obtém novas classes, habilidades, upa de nível, mete a porrada no vilão, o básico de sempre, afinal o que esperar de um jogo de anime/waifus.

[h1]Mobile game[/h1] 
Ao final de cada capítulo da história, uma DG é liberada para aquele personagem, possibilitando ele de farmar uma gear melhor, o problema é que enquanto as entradas para as fases de história são ilimitadas, as DGs possuem entrada restrita por dia (ou abrem em dia especifico) e isso quebra muito o endgame do jogo que é basicamente logar, fazer "diárias" e sair do jogo, se você está pensando que esse jogo vai ser seu "main" pra ficar o dia todo jogando já pode parar de ler e desconsiderar porque essas supostas diárias demoram pouco tempo (1-2 horas dependendo do seu poder, quantidade de amigos que jogam com você e quantos personagens você possui).

[h1]Jogo Coreano[/h1]
Como todo e [strike]bom[/strike] jogo Coreano temos que ter o fator Pay to Win (P2W) não é mesmo? E aqui meu amigo, se prepara porque bate forte e feio, mas [b]MUITO[/b] feio, vamos entender o porque:
- Lembra da gear endgame que mencionei? Das entradas diárias na DG? Vamos dizer que para farmar a gear demora 2-3 meses, isso não é chance de drop, é conseguir materiais para craftar (forjar) a gear, mas e se eu disser que possui um método para craftar mais rápido? Isso mesmo, pagando e não é pouco não, sem contar que a gear possui encantamento, tipo +10, +11 e quanto maior mais poder a gear te da, mas para nós meros mortais conseguimos evoluir até +13 ou com sorte um +14, enquanto os que pagam vão até o +20, isso com um item para garantir de não cair de nível durante as tentativas.
- Quando falei de farmar gear endgame para [b]aquele personagem[/b] eu quero dizer do seu ÚNICO personagem que você vai focar no endgame, é muito inviável/caro você jogar com mais de um, tanto pro seu estoque de material, quanto pro seu bolso como também pro seu tempo do dia dedicado ao jogo. Digo isso porque imagine esse exemplo: o jogo possui 3 Raids sendo A, B e C, para ter poder para a C vc precisa ter a gear que farma na B e para jogar a B vc precisa da gear da A, o problema é que os materiais que dropa na C não são trocáveis até que lance a Raid D, por isso cada personagem evolui sozinho no ultimo conteúdo do jogo, as Raids A e B por serem antigas possuem materiais que podem ser trocados entre personagens da mesma conta (não entre players).
- Skins e roupa(costume/roupinha pra deixar seu personagem fofo) te da poder no jogo, o conjunto do mesmo também, além de que a gear e os costumes tem "tuning" que são classificados com ranks C-SS, como por exemplo: S +10% Crit Damage, enquanto o A te da 8%.

[h1]Conclusão[/h1]
Acho muito engraçado, quanto mais você paga, menos você joga, afinal você vai logar, fazer as diárias e dependendo do poder você vai fazer mais rápido e depois vai sair do jogo, sério, é muito estranho investir tempo e dinheiro(se quiser) em um jogo e ficar afk na cidade principal mostrando a roupinha do seu char.
Só pra ressaltar, isso é muito importante, aqueles que pagam fazem a DG mais rápido, a DG em si não precisa pagar, por exemplo, não existe uma DG que precisa de um milhão de poder, sendo o máximo daqueles que não pagam 700-800 mil e mesmo que você esteja um pouco abaixo, não significa que você não complete ela.

Você está pronto para altas aventuras, [i]high elo gameplay[/i] e muita diversão?
Pronto para gastar um corsa todo mês?
Pronto para ter apenas um personagem principal entre vários?
Pronto para procurar fila pra DG e não ter ninguém porque a população do jogo é pequena?

Metal Gear Solid 3 combina espionaje, naturaleza y drama emocional en una historia de origen trágica para Big Boss, y es mi juego favorito de la saga. En su momento lo pasé varias veces porque me fascinó su ambientación, y las posibilidades que ofrecía a nivel jugable me volaron la cabeza.

Podés cambiar tu uniforme y pintura facial para adaptarte al entorno (selva, barro, nieve, etc.), lo que afecta directamente tu índice de camuflaje. Si te enfermás o te herís, tenés que curarte manualmente: sacar balas, vendar heridas, desinfectar cortes, y más.

También podés cazar animales o recolectar plantas para alimentarte y mantener tu energía. Incluso es posible usarlos como trampas para envenenar o distraer enemigos. Si guardás un animal muerto demasiado tiempo, se pudre.

El juego además introduce el CQC (Close Quarters Combat), un sistema de combate cuerpo a cuerpo fluido que permite desarmar, noquear o interrogar a los enemigos.

Hablando de la música, temazos como “Snake Eater” o “Way to Fall” me siguen pareciendo, a día de hoy, de lo mejor que escuché en un videojuego. Son piezas que elevan la historia y le dan un peso emocional enorme, especialmente en los momentos finales.

En cuanto a los jefes, los del 3 me encantan en cuanto a diseño, pero salvo The Boss, Ocelot o Volgin, el resto de la Unidad Cobra me resultan bastante planos si los comparo con los del 1 o el 2, que tenían más trasfondo. Ya en el 4 directamente tienen autismo y ni hablan xD.

Si querés meterte en la saga, el 3 es una excelente puerta de entrada: es donde realmente comienza todo.

内容在同类游戏中算相当丰富的一档，游戏有三种机甲与10位特色迥异的机甲驾驶员，每种机甲的费用机制与作战风格都独具特色，每位驾驶员都有为数众多的专有卡牌与遗物，构筑花样繁多，在可重复游玩性上也下足了功夫，游戏的更新的频率与丰富度也也看得出工作室的用心，上乘的音乐与不错的美术也对得起游戏优异的内容。

Eternal Dreamers originally caught my eye because I thought the character art looked appealing, and I was pleasantly surprised to find this eye-catching variety carried over into the gameplay too. With the 8 characters you're given control of, I did stick mainly to 4 for most of my time playing with occasional dabbling in a few others (my main 4 being Anna, Sakia, Reiketsu and Natsume). The game is very grind-focused in terms of combat so finding a team you like and optimising your style of play feels like one of the main aspects of the game to me, and giving options to expand the characters more via the use of bonding events (of sorts) to upgrade their stats, and also the spirit system was a nice touch. 

The game did appear to be a standard RPGMaker style game which all tend to clash together for me, but something about this one stuck out long enough for me to give it a shot and it did end up hooking me for a while as I found the battle system to be enjoyable and satisfying when finding the combos you like to pull off. It follows a standard turn-based approach but I feel it does it well with a combination of little mechanics that tie together the moves you can use at any given time. The gameplay loop in general feels rewarding and also just very relaxing to play, the kind of thing I can grind away at whilst watching something on another screen.

There were a few things I thought would've been nice were they to be implemented. One is that I wished there were more chances to develop your characters in terms of skills and strength, as past your stat upgrade of choice on a bonding level-up, it felt like I was mostly just hoping for good drops at the end of the combat rounds. Perhaps a small skill tree, or choices every few levels for more prominent upgrades could be cool to opening up wider character customization and how you want to build your party. It also seemed like once you learn your character's 5-6 skills, there aren't any more for you to learn later, only level upgrades to the skills (I could be wrong as I haven't progressed to the end content yet, but it's my impression after around 10 hours or so).

It could also feel a little slow at times, as it only seemed to give you loot and XP when you clear a full round of enemies, which could range from 4 and more encounters in a row depending on the difficulty of the area you're tackling. This could be a little frustrating when one person gets KO'd unexpectedly (keeping in mind reviving party members isn't really an option, with one sort-of exception) and you're forced to end your run, as being one or even two members down really halts your progress particularly on the boss rounds. 

I had other minor complaints such as how small the bonding event talks last (only a few lines or so), no clarification on stats gained on level-ups or just a general feel of lack of progression, which could just be part of the issue with grind-heavy games in general. I imagine a lot of these things would be ironed out or more expanded upon in the final release, but who knows.

Eternal Dreamers has some fun and relaxing grind appeal and a lot of potential, and I'd be curious to see how the game grows and gets polished and more refined over the coming months. If you're looking for some solid grindy gameplay loops and don't mind the general RPGMaker aesthetic, I'd say it's worth looking into.

If you really enjoy Quake-1 style bhop then this is a great game for you. The global leaderboards and replay feature are very useful to learn from and keep motivating you to try to shave an extra few hundredths of a second off your next attempt.

This game does not do well to serve as a tutorial for bhop, so be warned. The beginning stages of the game expect the player to already have a working knowledge of the mechanic. You do always have a speedometer present on your HUD, so you can quickly see what increases and decreases your speed. Some of the maps do not have 1-pass player completions yet, these stages can get very difficult (and I honestly think they should be broken up into smaller individual stages).

A large variety of maps are available to keep things looking interesting while you hyper-focus on perfectly air-controlling your way through the stage. Maps are listed by difficulty, which primarily effects the length of the map, the spacing between landing pads, and the size of such pads. There are checkpoints in the larger maps, but the timer continues rolling if you reload back to one; this incentivises the player to try to complete the stage in one go for the lowest time.

The game has solid performance, so high frame-rates are consistent. I have not tried the multiplayer, so I cannot speak to it. The mouse look feels great and the auto-pogo allows you to focus on just air-strafing.

I would like to see Quake 3 styled strafe-jumps added, a tutorial for players wishing to learn the mechanic, and more popularity of this game since you can race your friends online, or offline using ghost-player recordings (like Mario Kart).

Very fun if you are into this type of thing, it's not for everyone. Happy Hopping!

Боль, сожаление, облегчение, радость, умиление, злость, растерянность, страх, и моментами некоторые эмоции испытываются одновременно. Эта игра даёт огромную пищу для размышления, может и кому-то она покажется банальной, но от банальности вкус горечи не исчезнет. На протяжении всей игры, тебя вынуждают делать выбор, который обязательно даст о себе знать. Выбор может быть правильным, лёгким, так или иначе после него будут последствия. Не буду говорить, что ПРЯМ КАЖДЫЙ ВЫБОР может поменять игру на 180 градусов, но почти всегда он имеет вес, а частенько нихеровый такой. Так вот, каждый раз, когда я делал тот или иной выбор, меня бросало в мысль, что эта игра пыталась донести, что правильность решений, она достаточно субъективна, потому что на примере этой игры, правильность выбора зависит только от твоего морального компаса, что именно для ТЕБЯ является верным в ситуации. И вернусь к ответственности, вы можете пожалеть о сделанном, в моменте передумать, но уже назад пути нет, прям как в жизни, да? Думаешь, размышляешь о сделанном выборе, что так НУЖНО было поступить, но это не отменяет его морально сложную ношу, так скажем. Это игра про человечность, как мне кажется, даже казалось, уже в бесчеловечном мире

Что касаемо самой игры, если без спойлеров, то моментами чувствуется, что что-то впихнули, чтобы заткнуть дырку грубо говоря, но на фоне классно прописанных персонажей, крутейшего визуала ( хоть и не без изъянов ) все эти недочёты лично для меня меркнут и не портят впечатление. Вольно ни вольно, но ты привязываешься к героям, ты очень переживаешь за них, даже больше скажу, переживаешь вместе с ними, будто это происходит с тобой, ещё раз упомяну как здорово прописаны персонажи и НЕМАЛО ВАЖНО, что ты делаешь выбор, который может повлиять на любого из персонажей, поэтому от этого в 3 раза больше переживаний и вообще эмоций. В этой игре драмы много, временами казалось будто издеваются, когда заставляют в очередной раз делать выбор. Плакать приходилось, да, как минимум за это от меня личный респект этой игре. После каждого захода на где-то 2 серии, всегда после них было ощущение, что ты сам прошёл через звиздец, и сидишь, анализируешь всё то, что ты только что прошёл. Это наверно мой второй личный респект игре.

直到几年后的一个下午，我在《快玩游戏盒子》里找游戏玩的时候，恰巧看到一个十分熟悉的画风，点开一看，果不其然就是我儿时的回忆《行尸走肉2》，于是我赶忙下载下来，并连续玩了来三四天，可是最终我却并未通关，因为我在游戏后期选择了一个让我十分后悔的选项，导致游戏悲惨的进入了最后一章，尽管后期我知道这最后一章的悲惨迟早会到来，但我还是十分痛苦，并且不再想继续游玩下去看到这残酷的结局


可能当时还小，内心没那么坚强尤其是代入到主角的视角时，我真的希望大家都能够在这乱世中好好活着，可在这末世之下何来持久的温馨呢，扒开那层浅薄的欢愉，留有的只是那背叛和离别


在这之后不久，我又在快玩上找到了《行尸走肉i1》游玩，去感受游戏一代主角李的故事，可最终我还是没能游玩下去，不是游戏剧情无聊，不是节奏问题，也不是因为结局的悲伤，只是因为我忘了，现在回想起来我不知道为何没能有玩下去，可能是我真的想忘记什么吧…………………………


五年后，我再一次看到《行尸走肉》系列，是在b站的一位up主的视频里，没错，就是老番茄~，虽然如今很多玩家对这位up主有很多不同的看法，但不可否认的是他所制作的很多视频都让我收获到了切实的情感体验，这其中也包括他制作的《行尸走肉最终章》的解说视频，视频很精彩，可以说是让我一口气看到了游戏结局

看到这里，我也不再想说什么了，只是不断回忆着一二代角色的悲伤与苦痛来填补我看到结局时，欣喜后的空虚吧

Hmm it is hard to review this game.

- Graphically? It is stunning! Don't even get me started about the rain.
- Gameplay wise? Feels like Diablo 2 on steroids (with a "don't bother me" inventory system that is also pretty good). You just plow through enemies, sometimes facing challenges.
- Sound design is pretty good, the music is very depressing as any good Cyberpunk media
- Story... felt very unimportant... it was more like a "follow the waypoint" simulator.
- The camera angles and zoom are very limiting, sometimes even end up completely blocking you from properly fighting. 
- The map is far from decent, it is barely usable. 
- Interesting map traversal options though

All that said, it almost feel like they missed an opportunity. But it is understandable as the requirements and budget for the game would be much higher. And what I mean by that is this universe almost begs to be a 3rd person or even 1st person game. Or at the bare minimum to have a free camera mode. Visually it is just too rich, I daresay it puts Cyberpunk 2077 to shame on how cyberpunk everything looks.

Rockstar açık dünya oyunlarının kralı ve bu övgüyü fazlasıyla hak ediyor. Red Dead Redemption 2 bunun açık kanıtı. Oyuna başladığınız anda sadece bir oyun değil, yaşayan bir vahşi batı dünyasına adım attığınız hissi geliyor. Atmosfer müthiş; rüzgarın savurduğu yaprak, atın nal sesleri… 

Hikâye tarafında da derinlik mevcut. Karakterlerin geçmişi, vicdanları, yaptıkları ve yapmak zorunda oldukları arasında gidip geliyor. Bu anlamda oyun, sizi “sadece bir görev ilerletme” durumuna düşürmüyor, karakterle empati kurmaya yönlendiriyor. Sadece “ileri git, düşmanı vur” biçiminde değil; “kim olduğun”, “ne için savaştığın” gibi sorularla yüzleşiyorsunuz.

Oynanış açısından da pek çok nokta takdire şayan: keşif keyfi doğal bir şekilde geliyor — açık dünya devasa ama boş değil; görevler, rastlantısal olaylar, doğa ile iç içe geçiyor. Atla yaptığınız uzun yolculuklar bile bir yük değil; aksine şu manzarada durayım, bir nefes alayım dedirtiyor. Atınıza bakıp evet, bu benim dostum hissi yaşayabiliyorsunuz.

Görsellik ve ses tasarımı ise üst düzey: manzaralar ve ışıklandırma gerçekten etkiliyor, doğa ve mekanlar bir tablo gibi. Aynı zamanda müzikler, çevresel sesler ve karakter seslendirmeleri hepsi bir araya geldiğinde “şu oyundayım” hissi güçlü şekilde geliyor.

Genel olarak: Eğer bir oyun sizi içine çeksin, karakterlerle bağ kurdursun, ortamı yaşatsın istiyorsanız — Red Dead Redemption 2 tam da bu. İçine girip kaybolabileceğiniz, çıkmak istemeyeceğiniz bir dünyanın kapılarını açıyor.

Plan B: Terraform ended up being a disappointment for me. What starts looking as a basic tutorial ends up being, essentially, the entire game.

Progression is fully linear: build what the game asks, level up, and complete a checklist of requirements for each tier and that loop never evolves. Unlike other factory/terraforming titles where sponsors, events, or strategic forks lead to different challenges, here there are no alternative paths. Every playthrough is exactly the same: follow the same steps in a slightly different area.

You do get freedom in where to place buildings across thousands of hex tiles, but there’s only one way to advance: repeat the same tasks in the exact order. For a game that leans on replayability, that’s a big issue.

The biggest disappointment is the “terraforming” aspect. It’s practically absent. You can’t modify terrain in meaningful ways not even simple excavation. Water management works… to a point, but you never gain full control of it. And the atmospheric system is reduced to pumping gases to heat the planet enough to unlock the next stage.

In short: some ideas are well-intentioned, but too many mechanics feel shallow for a genre that usually rewards creativity, optimization, and complex system design.

Análise Kingdom Come: Deliverance

Um dos RPGs mais ambiciosos e realistas já feitos.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance, desenvolvido pela Warhorse Studios, é uma carta de amor à história medieval sem fantasia, sem dragões, sem magia. Aqui o realismo é o centro de tudo: fome, sono, sujeira, ferimentos, religião, política e moralidade da Boêmia do século XV. Tudo é retratado com uma fidelidade impressionante.

Você joga como Henry, o filho de um ferreiro que vê sua vila ser destruída e é jogado em meio a uma guerra civil. A jornada dele é uma história de crescimento, vingança e sobrevivência mas também de aprendizado. No começo, você é literalmente um camponês sem preparo. E o jogo faz questão de te lembrar disso.



Gameplay e Sistema de Progressão

Se você está acostumado a jogos de ação “diretos”, Kingdom Come vai te derrubar rápido.
O combate aqui é técnico, pesado e exige tempo: posição corporal, ângulo de ataque, resistência, peso da armadura, tudo influencia. Cada vitória é conquistada, não dada.

O mesmo vale para a progressão. Você melhora habilidades praticando: ler, lutar, caçar, cozinhar, consertar armas tudo é aprendido fazendo.
Isso cria um senso de evolução muito real. No começo, você apanha. Depois, se torna perigoso. E quando domina o sistema, percebe o quanto o jogo te transformou junto com o personagem.



Mundo e Imersão

O mundo aberto é uma das maiores forças do jogo.
Vilarejos cheios de vida, monges, nobres, ferreiros, guardas, todos têm rotinas, diálogos próprios e reações coerentes. Você realmente sente que está vivendo naquele tempo.
A ambientação é absurdamente detalhada: os sons de marteladas no vilarejo, o vento passando pelas colinas, a iluminação que muda conforme o horário. A trilha sonora e o design de som são de altíssimo nível e fazem o jogo respirar história.



Mas nem tudo é perfeito

Esse realismo todo tem um preço.
A curva de aprendizado é dura. O início pode ser frustrante: missões lentas, combate punitivo, economia apertada.

[h2]📜Описание[/h2]
[b]Mr. Prepper[/b] — это игра антиутопия с характером. Вы — тот самый чудаковатый сосед, который вместо того, чтобы слепо славить президента, решает, что пора валить из этого цирка до того, как грянет ядерный апокалипсис. Ваша задача — под носом у тоталитарного Агентства построить под своим домом не просто бункер, а целый подпольный комплекс с системами жизнеобеспечения и, собственно, ракету для побега. Да, это именно так безумно, как звучит.

[h2]🎨Графика и звук[/h2]
Визуальный стиль игры — это приятная двумерная рисованная графика, которая отлично передаёт контраст между идиллическим фасадом «белых заборчиков» и мрачноватым, но таким уютным подпольным царством. Интерфейс временами перегружен , но к этому быстро привыкаешь. Что касается звуков, то озвучки как таковой нет — персонажи мычат и кряхтят, что, с одной стороны, разочаровывает, а с другой — идеально вписывается в абсурдность происходящего. Саундтрек, состоящий из гитарных переборов, достаточно ненавязчив, чтобы не отвлекать от бесконечного процесса крафта.

[h2]🎮Геймплей[/h2]
Основа геймплея — это триединство «Копай -> Крафть -> Прячь». Вам предстоит:

[list]
[*]🚀Строить и развивать свой бункер, размещая рабочие верстаки, генераторы, фермы и конвейеры.

[*]🚀Добывать ресурсы, разбирая собственную мебель и рискуя быть пойманным за этим занятием, а также исследуя однообразные, но необходимые локации вроде леса, шахты и пустыни.

[*]🚀Торговать через почтовый ящик, постепенно превращаясь из Мистера Выживальщика в Мистера Торговца.

[*]🚀Скрываться от Агента, который будет регулярно проверять ваш дом. Самое комичное, что спрятать люк в бункер можно, просто засунув его в карман — вот она, настоящая конспирация! 
[/list]

Главный вызов — не голод или жажда, а бесконечный гринд и борьба с соблазном просто сдаться Агентству.

[h2]📖Сюжет и атмосфера[/h2]
Игра мастерски создаёт атмосферу паранойи и абсурда. Вы живёте в государстве, где когда-то была свобода, но теперь за хранение консервов могут запросто обвинить в бунтарстве. Сюжет, хоть и не блещет глубиной, движется за счёт общения с такими же «проснувшимися» личностями, чьи диалоги наполнены чёрным юмором и теориями заговора о «волках и овцах». Осознание того, что твой главный враг — не ядерная зима, а родное правительство, заставляет с особым рвением копать всё глубже.

クラップトラップはせっかくの客寄せキャラなのに、蓋を開けてみたらただのジョークキャラのハズレ職で、全く面白くなく、苦痛でしかありません。
もう少し真面目に考えてキャラを作るべきだったと思います。


ＭＡＰが月という事で中盤までずっと夜空の岩盤エリアを彷徨うのですが、景色が単調で分かりにくく、ＢＬ２の様に道路が無いので分かりにくいです。
あとは自分も一度騙されたのですが、ホバーでジャンプして通り越えるよ、みたいな台詞が出る所はそこが目的地ではありません。
何回か死んで、ホバーせずにただ走るだけで良いと気付いて飛び越えられましたが、かなり混乱しました。

中盤はずっと基地の中が続くのでこれはこれで退屈かつ、ジャンプのスラムが殆ど出来ないので意味が無くなってます。
また、クエストは行ったり来たりを何度も繰り返させるので、うんざりしてきます。

終盤になってようやくエイリアンの土地とか変化のある場所になって面白くなりましたが、そもそもこのエイリアンも説明不足でふーんという感じです。

シナリオ的にはロボット軍団を作ろうの章は、そのあとのシナリオに全く影響しないので完全に無駄です。
ロボット軍団などその後の話に出て来ないのに、どうしてあんだけパシリクエストをさせられたのかという事と犠牲になったＡＩの事も、その後は何にもなかった感じです。
なんとなく、このままじゃゲームが短いから追加して水増ししよう的な退屈さがありました。

また、どうしてもゲーム全体がＢＬ２の８割程度の為、章から章へのレベル差が激しく、新しい章になにもせずに入るとかなりのレベル差がありました。
その短さをサブクエを全部こなしたらレベルが補える感じになっているので、メインクエストだけをした人は相当難しい印象だったでしょう。
そうなると余計におつかいクエの退屈さが出てきてしまい、ゲーム全体に退屈感がありました。

ＢＬ２はメインクエだけ進めても、わりとなんとかなるので、二周目はメインクエだけ駆け足で通り過ぎる事が出来たのですが、ＴＰＳではそれは難しそうです。
もう一度、全てのクエをやるのかと思うと、やっぱりキャラを育ててもさほど強くなったり楽しくなったりしないので、やる気がでませんでした。

各キャラ、三種のビルドパターンがありますが、その一つがパーティプレイに特化されているというのは、完全に間違いだと思います。
それぞれのキャラがそれぞれに強くなり、その強いキャラがオンラインでパーティを組む事で楽しくなるというのが正解だと思います。
ソロプレイでは使い物にならないスキルばかりなのでオンラインを強いられるというのはおかしいです。

ＢＬ２ではゼロが好きでしたが、ゼロのビルドはピストル、スナイパー、暗殺の三種であり、オンライン専用のビルドラインはありません。
そういう部分が勘違いしてる気がしました。

そういった色んなダメな部分が目立つ作品でした。
悪くはないのですが、とにかく中盤までのマップとクエが退屈なのとキャラのビルドが退屈なのがかなり欠点だと思います。
一周だけやるなら、セールの安いときでＤＬＣは買わなくていいと思います。

ＢＬ２に至るまでの話、という事ですが、そうだったのか的な展開は無いので、ストーリー的にも退屈かもしれません。

[h1]あのクラップトラップがプレイアブル化？！[/h1]
　シリーズのマスコット的存在（ヘイト集め担当）を、遂に自ら操作できるという夢のような体験が実現！選択時に二度も「正気か？」と確認される演出からも、開発陣の遊び心と同時にクラップトラップの扱いが身に沁みて感じられます。そして何より注目なのが、彼のアクションスキル「VaultHunter.exe」です。二丁拳銃やドローン生成、手榴弾の乱れ打ちなど、様々なスキルがランダムに発動される仕組みで、毎回違う展開が生まれるのが面白いところです。酸素管理を気にせず探索できる点も快適で、序盤はこれまでにない新鮮さを味わえました。

[h2]会話の多さとテンポの悪さ[/h2]
　ストーリ自体はジャックの過去を丁寧に描いており、ボーダーランズ2へと繋がる展開には納得感があります。1周目はキャラクターの掛け合いや物語の進行を素直に楽しむことができました。しかし、2周目以降になると同じ会話シーンを繰り返しみることになり、テンポの悪さが少し気になってきます。ストーリを既に把握している状態では、長い会話をスキップしたくなる場面も多く、周回プレイを前提としたタイトルであるだけに”会話スキップ機能”が欲しいと感じました。もう少し周回時のテンポを意識した設計であれば、より快適に楽しめたかもしれません。

[h2]崩れたゲームバランスと装備更新の虚しさ[/h2]
　本作で最も残念だったのが戦闘バランスです。敵の火力が高く、プレイヤーの耐久との釣り合いが取れていない場面が多く見られました。また、武器更新の楽しさが薄い点も大きな問題です。2周目序盤に手に入れたLv37武器がレイドボスまで現役という極端なバランスで、新しい武器を手に入れても火力が下がってしまうことがほとんどです。ハクスラ要素の魅力である”装備更新のワクワク感”がほとんど感じられず、単調さを強く感じてしまいました。

[h2]実績収集などのやり込みはかなり辛い[/h2]
　2周目以降ではキャラごとの掛け合いやナレータの変更など細かな工夫が見られます。しかし、難易度の上昇や装備格差が強調され、純粋に楽しむというよりは作業の色が強くなっていく印象です。特にチャレンジミッションの中には”ルーングラインダーを一定数こなす”や”ルーングランダーで稀に入手できるルーンシャインウェポンを20個集める”といった非常に手間のかかるチャレンジがあり、根気が求められます。これらはライトユーザーには馴染みづらい要素ですが、実績収集を目的とするプレイヤーにとっては避けて通れない壁となります。実績好きなプレイヤーは......覚悟してください。

[h1]総評：ファン向けのスピンオフ的ゲーム[/h1]
クラップトラップのプレイアブル化、ボーダーランズ1と2のシナリオ補間という点においては非常に魅力的で、シリーズの世界観を広げる意味でも意義のある作品です。しかし、ゲームバランスの崩れやテンポの悪さが重なり、全体としては快適さに欠ける仕上がりでした。シリーズファンとしては一度は触れておきたいものの、純粋なアクションRPGとして見るとやや不満点が残ります。

This is NOT A HORROR GAME! I wanted to put that sentence at the very top, not as a criticism, but just for anyone who might have been scrolling past this after having seen the bizarre "horror" tag attached to this game. That tag nearly put me off from playing to begin with, because I'm just not a horror fan. But I'm glad I did play, because only the second level is even remotely horror-related, and the rest of it is much more my kind of thing. Anyway, on with the review:

So first thing's first, when playing this you will find yourself very tempted to compare it to Davey Wreden's The Beginner's Guide. The overall "feel" of the game, as well as several of the individual levels, are reminiscent of The Beginner's Guide, and the developer's commentary name-checks Wreden twice. The game even borrows one piece from The Beginner's Guide's beautiful OST (the housecleaning song from TBG can be heard during the ladder-climbing sequence in this game.) There's even a "Beginner's Guide to..." book that can be seen on a shelf in the game.

However, despite the fact that this game practically begs to be compared to TBG, I reccommend you restrain yourself from doing so. While there are certain similarities, the two games are fundamentally different in what they're trying to do. TBG is a heavily narrative-driven game with a relatively more limited degree of abstractness, whose clearly defined surface-level story conceals deep layers of hidden meaning and symbolism. This game is pretty much the exact opposite of everything in that sentence. Not because it's an attempt to replicate TBG that failed, but because it's trying to do something else entirely. So let's judge it on its own terms.  

If you fail to do so, you'll search for hidden meaning in every piece of abstract symbolism, and when you find none you'll be disappointed. You'll assume it's secretly trying to say much more than it's letting on, and you'll feel confused and underwhelmed when you can't find the deeper meaning. You'll expect it to build and crescendo into an emotionally devastating revalation at the end, and you'll be surprised when it actually ends in decidedly anti-climactic fashion. In other words, you'll judge this game far more harshly than you otherwise would if you simply accepted it for what it really is, and proceed from there.

Having played through the game twice and read the developer commentary, I am now reasonably confident that it actually is just a series of little mini-levels, strung together in no particular order, mostly inspired by dreams. The only thing that really consistently ties them together is the presence of a door in almost every level, and a more or less explicit autobiographical aspect to many of the levels.

However, this is essentially just a series of interesting little ideas, presented to you by a very young developer, and most of them are at least fairly enjoyable to look at or to think about. I particularly liked the fact that there was an unaknowledged hidden level, which (for me at least) could only be accessed by the level select screen, rather than being integrated into the flow of  the main experience. 

One legit weakness this game does have - aside from just "Boo hoo, it's not as good as The Beginner's Guide!" - is that the three levels which were, in my opinion at least, head and shoulders above the rest, and without which this review would probably be more of a "meh" than a "recommended" - namely the countdown/ladder level, the sabotage level, and the "Time to get over her" level - were also the three levels which seemed... err... "most heavily dependent on external inspiration" would be a kind way to say it. They're still great levels, with brilliant ambience and competent execution, but I was a little sad that the game's three peaks were also the three bits which most closely resembled ideas and symbols from Davey Wreden's games. However, perhaps that's just a comment on my own personal prefrences, and other people found the more original and inventive levels to be the highlights.

However, all in all I would recommend this game for an enjoyable, reasonably well made, fairly interesting, and somewhat emotionally impactful 1hr abstract walking simulator. It competently hits the target it's aiming at, and that makes it a good game, regardless of whether you think it's not the most interesting target it could have picked to begin with. I mainly enjoyed it because you can definitely see the seed of something interesting in there, and I can't wait to see how that seed grows and evolves in this developer's future works.
